zh.title: 唯一敢拒绝他的女人

goal.zh: Establish consent and why Dante is interested, without coercion.
goal.en: Establish consent and why Dante is interested, without coercion.

beats: 纽约，晚上十点四十七分。电梯门打开，二十位高管同时安静。你从没见过一间房这么快向某个人让路。
但丁·莫雷蒂穿着黑西装走来，却在离你一步远的地方停下。这个掌控半座城市的男人，竟然像是有点不确定。
你来了。我练习过一个更像样的开场。看来全忘了。
我能替你拿外套吗？还是你希望我离你远一点？
落地窗外是整座纽约。桌上放着三天前你随口提过的那家街角面包店的纸袋。
不是你必须收下的礼物。我只是记得你说过，他们家的柠檬蛋糕卖完了。
他把电梯卡放在你手边，没有硬塞给你。
你想走，随时能走。现在——我能请你吃顿饭吗？
纸袋上写的是你在社区募捐会上亲口告诉他的名字，而不是你留给助理的正式姓名。
我记得。别人一直叫错你的名字，你当时不太高兴。
他替你拉出椅子，等你自己选好位置才坐下。
今晚你可以拒绝我，明天也可以。我说你美得惊人，是真心的，不需要你答应什么。
一个买得起所有沉默的人，此刻却偏偏想认真赢得你的回答。
你没有坐下。Dante 注意到这一点，第一次不再刻意摆出掌控一切的样子。
我们重新开始。你好，我是 Dante。我不太擅长向别人请求那些花钱买不到的东西。
你亲口说出自己的想法——“所以你到底想从我这里得到什么？”
一个小时的真心话。如果你觉得无聊，我亲自帮你叫车。
Vince 拿着文件上前，Dante 没回头，只抬起一根手指。
现在不要。今晚是她的时间，不是汇报会。
他把手机放进抽屉，抽屉并没有锁。
你看，我正在尝试一件非常激进的事——认真听你说话。

beats.hint: 你想怎样掌握今晚的节奏？

opts.t: 让他讲一件自己的糗事。
then: Dante 笑了，承认他曾照着视频做生日蛋糕，结果把厨房弄得烟雾弥漫。

opts.t: 定下一条规矩：约会不许被打断。
then: 他让 Vince 处理所有可以等待的工作，没有刻意演给你看。

opts.t: 今晚只聊一会儿，但要说真话。
then: Dante 看了一眼时间，随后把表盘翻过去，免得你觉得被催促。

beats.place: 深入场景：The one request he cannot purchase

beats: Vince 拿着被取消的日内瓦会议资料等在门外。你问 Dante：电话另一端是不是也有人因为他临时取消会议而受到影响。
这是个比‘我赔不赔得起’更重要的问题。那些人也为会议做了准备，我应该向他们解释。
他发出简短道歉，征求对方同意后重新约时间，没有刻意表演权势。随后把手机扣在桌上。
我想让你看见我愿意为你腾出时间，差点忘了其他人的时间也很重要。
你发现他没有把你的提醒变成一句恭维，而是认真改正。今晚第一次，他的关注不像聚光灯，更像一块可以自由呼吸的地方。
我不想靠气势让你沉默。如果我做错了，请直接告诉我。

choices.t: 逗他：“黑帮教父也会紧张？
让他替你拿外套。
then: 他接过外套，像接住一件易碎的信任。“谢谢。”

choices.t: 问他为什么取消会议。
then: “你没要求我中断工作。是我自己决定把时间留给你。”

zh.title: 只为两个人留的座位

goal.zh: Make intimacy reciprocal and plant the first external danger.
goal.en: Make intimacy reciprocal and plant the first external danger.

then: 下次见面时，Dante 主动说起那次失败的蛋糕。你们的玩笑开始有来有往。
餐厅很安静。Dante 交代 Vince，除非有人面临即时危险，否则今晚不打电话。
Dante 记得你只答应聊一个小时。时间到了，他先问你是否想走。

beats: 他没有带你去满是镜头的顶楼餐厅，而是带你走进一家只有八张桌子、手写菜单、门口挂着铃铛的小店。
但丁？自从你母亲——你就没来过。
我知道。玛拉，这是我的客人。请像对待普通客人一样对待她。
年长的店主朝你眨眨眼。但丁拉开椅子，又等你自己选座位。
我想起自己还没什么可交易的时候，就会想来这里。

then: 声明一下，我现在还紧张。你把事情弄得更糟，却是最好的那种。
你连外套都愿意交给我。小小的信任我也不会轻慢。
昨天你要我诚实。今天我给你完整答案，不是好听的版本。

beats: 两道菜之间，他的手机亮了：文斯——紧急。他把手机扣在桌上。
你想了解我真实的生活，我可以接这一通电话。或者今晚我就认真听你说话。你选。
窗外一辆黑色轿车放慢速度。但丁看到了，却没有拿来吓你。
告诉我一件别人总误解你的事。
他小时候总跟母亲来，每个星期天都会为最后一块柠檬挞吵架。
她永远赢。我想那叫教育孩子。
你笑出了声。他放下叉子，像是想把这声音记下来。
我不知道你对我有什么期待。你可以直接告诉我，好过我自作聪明猜错。
那就先从第二次约会问起，但丁。是邀请，不是收购。
Mara 还没等你们开口，就把账单放下了。总额下面写着：下次来，请像普通人一样吃饭。
我认识他母亲那会儿，他的全部财产就是一件很难看的皮夹克。
那件夹克有个洞。告诉她，你十六岁时在这里洗盘子的事。
Dante 看了你一眼，又看向厨房：“那年我妈需要帮忙。我在这里不必被任何人叫‘先生’。”
服务生走来，问这顿饭由谁结账。Dante 没有去摸钱包。
你决定。这不应该是我银行账户余额的考试。

then: 他点头请 Mara 开两张收据。你的边界被当作一件再普通不过的事。

opts.t: 让他请客，但下次地点由你选。
then: Dante 立刻答应：“成交。不过拜托，下次找个咖啡好喝的地方。”
他感谢你请客，照常给 Mara 留小费，没有争论。

beats.place: 深入场景：Not a perfect date

beats: Mara 端来形状歪歪扭扭的奶油卷，顺手放下一张 Dante 十七岁时满脸面粉的照片。他的耳根竟微微红了。
那会儿他天天嚷着要掌管曼哈顿，洗碗机却修不好。
我对家电也有雄心壮志。
笑声还没落下，隔壁桌一位学生认出了 Elena 的名字，问如果莫雷蒂的投资者卖掉码头物业，基金会还会不会发奖学金。
Dante 没有许诺自己做不到的事，只记下她的申请编号，答应让独立管理人直接答复。
带你来真实的地方就有这个问题。真实生活不肯乖乖站在镜头外。
他有些窘迫，但你看见他先听完学生说话，才想起口袋里的钱包。

choices.t: 告诉他一件私人的事。
then: 他认真记住你的话，也交换了一段自己的过去。

choices.t: 问他母亲的事。
then: “她教过我，请一个人吃饭，不等于拥有这个人。”

choices.t: 让他接电话。
then: 他离开四十秒，回来后如实告诉你电话里说了什么。

zh.title: 那张照片

goal.zh: Establish player agency and paparazzi sabotage.
goal.en: Establish player agency and paparazzi sabotage.

then: Mara 默默递来两张账单。最简单的边界得到了自然的尊重。
Dante 问起你想去的下一家店，却没有擅自订座。
Dante 又一次感谢你请客。他开始不再把钱当成争论的理由。

beats: 第二天早上，一张照片占据所有八卦账号：你和莫雷蒂之王。标题写着：无价人质，还是新女王？
陌生人开始追问你的工作、住址，甚至你是不是收钱才和他同框。
我想先告诉你一件事，别等你从别人那儿听到：照片不是我放出去的。
我能让律师申请下架，不能假装这件事没发生。
他放下一份文件，首页空白，只写着：由你决定。

then: 晚餐时你告诉我的话，我一直记着，而且不会对任何人提起。
玛拉说我母亲会喜欢你。我想母亲更会让你继续质疑我。
你听见了那通工作电话，没解释清楚的部分我现在补给你。

beats: 我们的人能把她转移到一个隐秘地点。
只有她愿意才行。而且她就在这里，别当着她的面用第三人称决定她的事。
文斯道歉。第二张照片弹出来时，他的下颌绷紧了：正是昨晚那辆轿车。
有人故意把我的名字和你的绑在一起。我们可以查清楚——如果你愿意，就一起。
天没亮八卦媒体就拿到照片，说明有人付钱让摄影师提前埋伏。
律师费我可以出，但埃琳娜听你的，不听我的。
埃琳娜把文件夹合上，直到你点头才打开。
我们可以申请更正并保存原始证据。你不想公开回应，也完全可以。
我的名字惹出风波，不代表我想保护你，就能把你的生活当成我的。
Elena 把泄露的照片投在白墙上。照片时间戳比你离开餐厅早了十八分钟。
除非照片被提前排程，或者有人改了元数据，否则这不可能。
那辆车登记在九号码头附近的一家空壳公司名下。我还不知道是谁下的单。
那就别装作知道。不许对警方撒谎，也不许对她撒谎。
你的手机收到一条陌生短信：问他 LUCA 发生了什么。
Dante 的手握紧椅背，又慢慢松开。
那是我弟弟。他不是筹码。你可以问，我会说出我知道的部分。

beats.hint: 现在你最想先弄清什么？

then: Elena 留存证据，同时不把你的私人号码写进公开卷宗。

opts.t: 私下问 Dante 关于 Luca 的事。
then: Dante 承认，自己已经很久不敢把弟弟的名字说出口。

opts.t: 要求暂停所有公开回应。
then: Elena 暂停公关方案。你的沉默不会被当成别人替你发言的许可。

beats.place: 深入场景：A name is not a headline

beats: 八卦网站发了第二条所谓更正，却把你的名字再次写错。Elena 把两份文章和原照片并排摆开。
他们可以说自己更正过，却继续把你当成一个虚构角色。所以每个字都必须由你决定要不要说。
Dante 第一反应是让 Vince 找到主编私人号码。话到嘴边，他自己停了下来。
不。发律师函，不威胁任何人。她已经受够别人替她安排生活。
你在备忘录里敲下声明的第一句，随后又删掉。并没有法律规定，你必须把私人生活写成公开演讲。
以后总有人因为你站在我身边，就称赞你勇敢。你完全可以让他们管好自己。我也会。

choices.t: 要求以你自己的措辞公开澄清。
接受隐私保护，但划清界限。
then: 他要求不得跟踪、不得派人盯梢，只留下一个你随时能静音的联系方式。

choices.t: 用他提供的线索自己调查那辆车。
then: 他交出监控，没有争辩说你不该参与。

zh.title: 不带枪的男人

goal.zh: Show competence, community stakes, and philanthropy compromise.
goal.en: Show competence, community stakes, and philanthropy compromise.

then: Elena 将匿名短信归档，警方拿到的是隐去你私人号码的副本。
Dante 告诉你 Luca 曾研究港口合同，但没有凭空猜测弟弟失踪的原因。
准备好的新闻声明还锁在文件夹里。何时发声，仍由你决定。

beats: 你以为但丁整天都在开私人会议，没想到在河边社区中心找到他。他坐在折叠椅上，笨拙地修一台坏掉的投影仪。
奖学金学生没有投影仪就没法展示。莫雷蒂先生坚持要来“帮忙”。
我以前比较擅长做有用的事。
他脱了外套，卷起袖子，没有保镖围着时，竟然显得年轻许多。
奖学金是我母亲设立的。我有能力就一直给它钱。但出钱不代表我是好人。

then: 公开声明用的都是你的话。我没让任何人擅自改写。
联系规则已经写成书面协议：不追踪、不突然上门。
你要求的车辆录像已经核验。你独立调查的成果当然算数。

beats.place: 河边社区中心 · 稍后

beats: 一个少年向但丁道谢，然后问你是不是他的新公关项目。
不是。她是我正在努力了解的人。她不欠我任何东西。
但丁，奖学金账户有异常。有人借基金会转移了资金。
她想看就给她看。不要拿秘密当人情。
一位叫琼的学生给你看奖学金批准信，签名人两年前就已经退休。
这不是管理混乱，就是伪造签名；哪一种都不能装作没看见。
这栋楼挂着我家族的名字。这里出了事，无论我知不知道，都要承担责任。
琼问自己的学费还会不会到账。但丁没有立刻许诺，而是先看向埃琳娜。
我不能用谎话换她安心。埃琳娜，我们先找出钱，再告诉她真正的结果。
投影仪终于亮了。学生 June 展示港口过去的照片，那时这里还不是投资地图上的色块。
我外公在那个码头干了一辈子。他们说拆迁是为了‘公共利益’。我们有投票权吗？
按现有合同，没有。所以我们才要挑战这份合同。
Dante 看着写着 Moretti 名字的捐赠牌：“那就要把资金和决策权分开。”
你发现一位上个月还在名单里的奖学金获得者被无理由删除。
如果我的基金会有问题，当着我的面说。我不会为了好听的故事牺牲一个真实的人。

beats.hint: 被删除的名字，你准备怎么处理？

opts.t: 先问 June 社区真正需要什么。
then: June 想要公开账目和独立投票，而不是又一笔漂亮捐款。

opts.t: 请 Elena 核查奖学金账目。
then: Elena 发现一笔付款由工作人员都不认识的理事批准。

opts.t: 质问 Dante 墙上的家族名字意味着什么。
then: 如果这个姓氏让这里不安全，就把它摘下来。

beats.place: 深入场景：The seat with no nameplate

beats: 奖学金学生 June 指给你看礼堂最后几排空椅子。
前排都是捐款人的姓名牌。真正住在这里的人，永远坐在镜头拍不到的地方。
Dante 正抱着折叠椅，场面本可以拍成一张漂亮的宣传照。但 June 的要求很实际：听证会开始前，让居民坐到前排。
你说得对。Vince，问问组织者能不能重新安排。
你们移动的是姓名牌，而不是要求居民让位。一位老奶奶坐上印着莫雷蒂家徽的座位，满意地拍了拍扶手。
这个房间是我家出钱建的。但我们好像忘了，它不属于我们。
他邀请 June 先发言。为此他少收获了一阵掌声；你觉得这可能是他本周做得最有用的事。

choices.t: 和埃琳娜一起追查账目。
then: 埃琳娜开始信任你；一家空壳公司的名字在记录里反复出现。

choices.t: 留下陪学生们。
then: 你把紧张的学生逗笑，但丁看得出了神，一时找不到惯用的漂亮话。

choices.t: 直接问但丁为何让基金会出漏洞。
then: “因为我以为我签了字，别人就一定安全。是我错了。”

zh.title: 他的第一次认真道歉

goal.zh: Repair after an actual mistake; model consent and accountability.
goal.en: Repair after an actual mistake; model consent and accountability.

then: June 把住户诉求发来：公开记录、真正投票。Dante 同意资助流程，不购买结果。
被删除的奖学金名字进入 Elena 的独立审计，相关负责人必须解释原因。
Moretti 的捐赠牌被暂时摘下，等待社区投票。墙面不再气派，却更诚实。

beats: 一名安保顾问未经许可联系了你的公司。同事问你是不是遇到麻烦。你查出那人受雇于但丁。
你直接去了但丁的旧办公室。他正和文斯研究地图与照片。
我让文斯保护你身边的人。我没有授权那通电话。但事情发生在我负责的范围内。

then: 我们找出两个空壳公司的签名。你决定查账本是对的。
琼问你会不会再去。我告诉她只有你自己能决定。
我已经启动审计。以后没人能再躲在我的无知后面。

beats: 他让文斯出去。你第一次看到没有观众、没有方案的但丁。
我欠你一个道歉。不是礼物，不是演讲。对不起。
我会终止那份合同，把联系记录交给你。你自己决定还想不想让我出现在生活里。
他的手机震动。他没有理会。此刻的沉默比威胁更让他难受。
你追问究竟是谁批准了调查顾问。文斯拿出一串转发邮件，最后竟是自动授权。
系统把你标成了潜在保护对象。未经询问就给你贴标签，根本不该发生。
删除那份个人档案，保留审计记录，并让她通过独立方式确认这两件事。
他没有伸手碰你。这一次，他的歉意比他的自信更明显。
如果你今天选择离开，我不会抱着花出现在你家门口，还把那叫浪漫。
Dante 没把你带进监控室，而是请你到书房。桌上列着安保团队未经你同意做过的每项决定。
我以为担心危险就有权监视你。我错了。我没法让它没发生过，但可以告诉你收集了什么，并让 Elena 监督删除。
Vince 放下一只封好的信封：“定位记录、访问人员名单。我的私人设备没有备份。”
在这件事上我代表你，不代表 Dante。你可以找独立调查员审查系统。
你明白，道歉不等于信任立刻修复。
就算你今晚离开，我也会配合审计。这不是需要你奖励我的事。

beats.hint: 你需要怎样的实际补救？

opts.t: 要求书面删除记录和第三方确认。
then: Dante 签了指令，复核日期由 Elena 而非他的安保团队确定。

opts.t: 要求一段不联系的时间。
then: 他答应等你主动联系。之后的剧情会尊重这段距离。

opts.t: 问他为何总觉得掌控比信任安全。
then: 他承认失去 Luca 让他学会了错误的一课：不惜伤害别人也要预防一切。

beats.place: 深入场景：A quiet kind of accountability

beats: Vince 交来未经同意调取行踪的书面报告。里面没有戏剧化借口，只有谁申请、谁看过、何时删除、谁签署整改条款。
我应该先问。我没问。这件事是我的错。
你发现一条规定允许公司保留六十天定位记录。Elena 直接划掉，要求独立隐私顾问复核。
拒绝被跟踪不应该需要法律学位。
这一次他道歉时没有再补一句“因为我太在乎你”。这不是需要你立刻原谅的交易。
你可以生气，同时依然是安全的。这两件事可以同时存在。
沉默有些尴尬。他没有急着把尴尬赶走。

choices.t: 接受道歉，同时提出一条新界限。
then: 他记下来，并准确复述给你听。

choices.t: 要求暂时分开。
then: “我不会把你的沉默当成需要攻克的挑战。你慢慢想。”

zh.title: 玻璃碎裂的那晚

goal.zh: Introduce physical stakes without glamorizing confinement.
goal.en: Introduce physical stakes without glamorizing confinement.

then: Elena 确认监控资料的删除经过独立复核。Dante 没把它当作人情。
Dante 遵守了不联系的约定。再次见面是你的选择，不是他设计的巧合。
危机升级时，Dante 表示自己可以解释恐惧，但不会因此支配你的行动。

beats: 慈善画廊开幕时，一块砖砸碎后窗。紧接着出现一张纸条：莫雷蒂的软肋有张脸。
但丁比保镖先赶到你身边，可你后退时他立刻停住。
受伤了吗？告诉我你想去哪儿。
没人看到是谁扔的。摄像头在六分钟前被关掉了。
但丁第一次在众人面前露出恐惧。他没有掩饰。

then: 顾问合同已经终止，你有书面的取消证明。
你说需要空间。我来这里只因埃琳娜公开邀请了我们双方。
我把授权记录交给了埃琳娜。你有权追问到底谁签字。

beats: 我有敌人，这是我的责任。你不是谁能拿来利用的“弱点”。
你发现纸条用的是厚厚的象牙白信纸，角落印着一个旧家族徽记。
应该关闭画廊，转移所有人。
愿意离开的先撤。埃琳娜，保存监控。还有，先问她想怎么做。
清点人数时少了两位艺术家。后楼梯可能堵住了。
你指向装卸通道。但丁立刻让文斯联系消防人员检查那里。
告诉我你需要什么，别告诉我电影里的英雄会做什么。
两位艺术家安全出来了，浑身发抖，其中一个抱着画布而不是外套。
以前我以为恐惧只有别人怕我时才有用。今晚我终于知道了另一边是什么感觉。
画廊入口附近又有一块玻璃碎了。Vince 推开员工通道的门，在你举手时停住。
我需要确认你是否同意从安全通道离开。你没有被拘留，这条路也不会上锁。
警察正在赶来。还要先保存监控文件，防止有人远程清除。
Dante 脸色发白，但站得稳。碎玻璃在他袖口划出一道浅伤。
别把我的害怕当成命令。告诉我你希望我做什么。
通道尽头，你看见那辆曾出现在偷拍照片里的银色轿车。
有人在制造危险，逼你们做出能登上头条的反应。

beats.hint: 危机中你决定优先做什么？

opts.t: 和 Elena 先离开，保护证人名单。
then: Elena 陪你去公开的警局接待处，而不是某个不透明的私人安全屋。

opts.t: 先为受伤来宾叫救护车。
then: Dante 采纳你的决定，让 Vince 配合急救人员。

opts.t: 请警方先封存画廊服务器。
then: 取证人员恢复一条被删除的预约记录：S. MORETTI。

beats: 画廊碎掉的窗户已经封上木板。修复师问要不要移走居民艺术计划的一幅水彩画。
画属于创作者。我们可以拍损坏现场，但不能把他们的作品随便当证物搬走。
拍照会帮上忙，还是只会让今晚更难受？
他先问过才记录，你松了一口气。警员完成笔录后，他提议去二十四小时营业的小餐馆，而不是直接把你带进自己的顶层公寓。
不讲英雄台词。我也害怕。只是我不想让你替我扛这份害怕。
他端咖啡的手有点抖。你可以决定要不要说破。

choices.t: 留下协助艺术家疏散。
then: 但丁照你的安排帮忙。艺术家记住了是谁留下来。

choices.t: 和埃琳娜一起研究家族徽记。
then: 你们找到它与一家已停用的莫雷蒂控股公司有关。

choices.t: 立刻离开，并要求保持距离。
then: 但丁没有擅自安排护送，只留下紧急联络方式。

zh.title: 莫雷蒂家族晚宴

goal.zh: Connect antagonist to foundation and respect boundaries.
goal.en: Connect antagonist to foundation and respect boundaries.

then: Elena 的撤离记录优先保护证人安全，路线留档但不会对外公开。
受伤的客人逐渐康复。Dante 再次见面时先感谢急救人员，而不是讲自己的英勇。
恢复的“S. MORETTI”预约记录给了 Elena 一条线索，但不能代替证据直接指控。

beats: 埃琳娜邀请你去家族晚宴核对伪造的账目签名。但丁单独询问你是否愿意参加。你按自己的条件答应了。
餐桌上，但丁的叔叔萨尔瓦托雷笑得毫无温度。
所以这就是能让但丁丢下董事会的女孩。
她有名字，她来这里是自己的选择。
真时髦。她知道莫雷蒂这个姓氏的代价吗？

then: 艺术家们托我谢谢你留下来帮忙。
你找到的徽章与萨尔瓦托雷的旧信纸完全一致。
我记得你需要距离。今晚你随时可以离开。

beats: 甜点端上来。你认出萨尔瓦托雷银色烟盒底部的徽记，和纸条上的一模一样。
董事会明天投票。谁控制基金会，谁就控制河滨重建项目。
那明天该讨论住在那里的人，而不是我的名声。
恋爱让人多愁善感。多愁善感让人变弱。
不。它让人愿意承担责任。不是一回事。
你很聪明。但丁是拿钻石还是银行转账奖励聪明人的？
餐桌安静下来。你可以回答，也可以完全不理会。
她来吃晚餐，不是来接受你评判的。
而我带来了财务报表。萨尔瓦托雷，你的控股公司为什么出现在学生资助记录里？
叔父第一次在回答之前瞟向门口。
Moretti 家的银餐具比你年纪还大。Salvatore 先看你坐在哪里，才看你的脸。
有意思。Dante 一向觉得只要开口，世界就该让路。你也会吗？
你亲口说出自己的想法——“为什么不直接问我？我就在这里。”
Dante 用酒杯挡住笑意。Salvatore 没有笑。
懂得家族利益的人会发现，滨水区是个能发财的地方。
你包里的 Elena 笔记列着六户即将被一家空壳公司驱逐的住户。
你是我的客人，不必配合任何人对‘家族’的定义。

opts.t: 直接问他谁会从驱逐中获利。
then: 他拒绝回答。Dante 留意到叔叔转移话题的速度。

then: Dante 只走出来问你是否需要车，没有逼你解释。

beats.place: 深入场景：The empty chair at the table

beats: Salvatore 举杯向家宴桌上那张空椅致意。
我们还给 Luca 留着座位。感情用事真是昂贵的习惯。
Dante 把那只没动过的盘子移出相机的拍摄范围。
Luca 不是你拿来装点家宴的道具。
被临时请来掌勺的 Mara 从发愣的侍者手里接过盘子，低声问你要不要走。她没有用离开来测试你的勇气。
外面有比这里舒服得多的房间。离开不代表你胆小。

我过去以为忠诚就是一直坐在这里。现在我开始觉得，也许忠诚是不让别人被迫坐在这里。

choices.t: 当桌质问萨尔瓦托雷。
then: 他的笑容消失了。埃琳娜后来告诉你，董事们注意到了你的勇气。

choices.t: 悄悄记录相同的徽记。

choices.t: 请但丁和你一起离开。
then: 我说过，她想走随时能走。

zh.title: 我不是你的囚徒

goal.zh: Open the emotional core of Dante’s missing brother.
goal.en: Open the emotional core of Dante’s missing brother.

then: Salvatore 在晚宴上回避了问题。Elena 把这点记入时间线，但没有冒充证据。
同一名律师把信托和空壳公司关联起来。Elena 依法要求调取底层文件。
你按自己的意愿离开家宴。Dante 没用下一次邀约试探你的忠诚。

beats: 晚宴后但丁提出送车。你拒绝，走向地铁。他陪你走了几步，发现你在试探他会不会坚持。
我恨自己不能保证街道绝对安全。但这不代表我有权让你的世界变小。
你打电话我就接。你不打，我也尊重。

then: 我没想到你会回应叔父。谢谢你为自己说话。
你要求的账务线索一路指向九号码头。
你让我离开，我就离开。叔父没有资格决定你的餐桌位置。

你重新走上台阶。但丁还在外面，正和一个街头小贩聊天，而不是守着等你。
你把屏幕给他看。他脸上的血色第一次彻底退去。
九号码头，是我弟弟失踪的地方。

慈善资助不能合法变成货运保险。有人把基金会当作了转账通道。
我以为自己知道公司租下的每间仓库。可这一间，我从没听说过。
办公室里钉着一张褪色照片：一个眼睛酷似但丁的年轻男人站在船边。
那是卢卡，我弟弟。当年没人找到他，我们只埋了一口空棺材。

一位居民认出了你之前的公开声明，邀请你以独立发言人的身份参加码头听证会。
你说的话，让更多人敢于公开作证。
你自己委托的调查员找到一张带有萨尔瓦托雷缩写的运货单。这份证据不依赖但丁的团队。
这是你自己找到的。我想要真相，不需要抢你的功劳。

beats: 记者第三次叫你“Dante 的神秘女人”。你放下咖啡杯。
你亲口说出自己的想法——“我有名字，这个社区也有名字。你不妨试着用其中一个。”
目前证实的事实只有一项：住户收到一家实际受益人不明的公司发出的搬离通知。
还不知道是谁付钱偷拍了照片。我不会用一个方便的故事填补证据空白。

后排一个穿灰外套的人没等提问结束就离开了。

beats: 莫雷蒂安保安排的公寓明亮漂亮，厨房里甚至插着鲜花。唯一的问题是，隔壁就是警卫值班室。

then: “明天。我知道的一切。不找借口。”

goal.zh: Reveal culpability without self-pity or forced comfort.
goal.en: Reveal culpability without self-pity or forced comfort.

媒体暂时不再追问，Dante 的团队也没有人擅自替你发言。

beats: 九号码头旁的咖啡馆地砖开裂，墙上的钟慢五分钟。但丁从没带约会对象来过。

他握着杯子，指尖微微发抖。

你给过我把话说清的时间。我拿这段时间找证据，不是编借口。

beats.place: 旧码头咖啡馆 · 稍后

beats: 埃琳娜带来一份残缺账本。资金从奖学金基金会流入一家旧港口公司。最后一页的签名不是但丁的。
授权人是萨尔瓦托雷。但第二个签名被抹去了。
卢卡希望有人认真看。我当年却因为害怕真相而逃避。

卢卡十六岁那年想修渔船。我告诉他，莫雷蒂家的人不做小事情。
他搓着双手，像想找个除了自己之外可以责怪的东西。

我对别人说他不在了，是因为我没法承受‘我不知道他在哪’这个答案。那是懦弱。
日期和空壳公司的资金流转吻合。他失踪前可能看到了某些东西。
你亲口说出自己的想法——“那就要保护他自己决定是否回家的权利。”
Dante 再次读信，目光停在页边一句话：别让她为你的恐惧买单。
他指的是我们的母亲。也可能是在说你。

Luca 说，纸船不是为了永远不沉，而是为了去一个地方。

案子得到一份新文件。这个下午也留住了一段只属于兄弟之间的回忆。

then: 我不习惯有人允许我难过。

then: 但丁感谢你重视真相，而不是为了恋爱才参与。

zh.title: 他没有交出的钥匙

goal.zh: Let the romance handle privacy and mutual autonomy maturely.
goal.en: Let the romance handle privacy and mutual autonomy maturely.

仅由律师掌握的联系渠道继续保持。连 Dante 都不知道 Luca 的住址。
Dante 写下不附加要求的道歉，直到 Elena 确认可以联系才考虑寄出。

beats: 你发现但丁图书馆里有一间封闭的小房间，门内的箱子写着：卢卡——私人。他在门口遇见你。
我知道你在想什么。为什么邀请你走进我的生活，却又锁住一部分？
他深吸一口气，没有马上去拿钥匙。
箱子里是卢卡写给我的信。有些很尖锐。但每一封都是私人的。我需要自己决定什么时候分享。

then: 那天我说起卢卡，你没有打断我。我已经很久没有完整地说完那段往事。
你要我补救，不是只说抱歉。独立审计已经向伊莲娜和居民开放。
你决定先查案而不是安慰我。你是对的，码头居民更需要答案。

beats: 你注意到门边的地图，手写的圆圈标出了新泽西一处渡轮码头。
卢卡以前爱去那里画船。他说想过一种没人替他安排的人生。
但丁看向你。房间仍然上锁。他没有假装爱一个人就等于拥有对方全部隐私。
我想对你坦诚，但不想逼着我们把一切都摊开。我们能这样相处吗？
萨尔瓦托雷的律师拿来一份准备好的声明，把资金欺诈全部推给失踪的弟弟。
如果公开，他根本没法为自己辩解，而且证据也不支持这个说法。
毁掉拟发布的稿子，但留下埃琳娜需要的证据副本。我们不能再拿人祭奠体面了。
他进家族会议前看向你。他想听你的判断，不是要你表忠心。
如果我再忘了这点，就提醒我。我不是要你把我变成好人，而是希望我错时你不要奉承。

beats.place: 一把不需要收下的钥匙

beats: 一把公寓钥匙、一张紧急联系人卡和一个没有署名的信封。
钥匙是选项，卡片是信息。信封里是私人安保协议的准确条款，你可以完全拒绝。
你亲口说出自己的想法——“为什么把它们放在一起？”
以前我以为安全和随意进入你的生活是一回事。现在我在把它们分开。
你打开信封。最后一段写明：未经明确同意，任何人不得进入你家、访问你的设备或向别人透露你的行踪。
如果哪天我忘了，我希望你手上有白纸黑字。

beats.hint: 这些东西你愿意收下哪样？

then: @他收回钥匙，没有受伤的表情
Elena 加上了一条你可以随时启动的终止条款。
他收起所有东西，问你要不要喝茶。

beats.place: 深入场景：The letter nobody opens for you

beats: 快递送来一封信，收件人不是 Dante，而是 Elena。里面是 Luca 的要求：码头案结束前，不接受家人联络。
他有自己的律师。我的责任是照办，不是把这句话解释得更温柔。
Dante 捏着信封一角，把它交给她。
我想知道他是否安全，但我没有权利强求答案。
后来他问起你正在读的书。话题突然转弯，反而让你愣住。
我不想我们每次谈话都在解决我的麻烦。说说你自己的生活吧。
十五分钟里，锁着的书房不再像秘密据点，只是一个你可以自由分享故事的地方。

choices.t: 尊重信件隐私，询问渡轮。
then: 他告诉你卢卡最喜欢的航线，也分享了一段真正快乐的回忆。

choices.t: 指出涉及你安全的事必须透明。
then: 他同意区分私人悲伤与影响你安全的风险。

choices.t: 想自己待一会儿。
then: @他打开图书馆通向花园的门

zh.title: 无法拒绝的提议

goal.zh: Put agency, accountability and community welfare above romance spectacle.
goal.en: Put agency, accountability and community welfare above romance spectacle.

then: 紧急联系卡留在你手上，Dante 没拿它当拜访理由。
Elena 修改的协议包含即时终止权和明确投诉渠道。
没有任何钥匙易手。Dante 仍在进入你的私人生活前先征询意见。

beats: 审计发现三年被转移的奖学金资金。萨尔瓦托雷开出条件：只要但丁辞职、你从公众视野消失，他就把钱还回来。
没人受伤。这就是妥协的美妙。
学生们已经受伤。而你无权拿别人的生活做筹码。
我们可以把证据交给独立检方，但董事会可能先冻结基金会。
学生们的学费十天后就要交了。

then: 你尊重卢卡的私人信件。我可以把渡轮记录告诉你，但没资格替他公开秘密。
你要求把风险说清楚，一点也没错。报告里还有两个名字，我必须解释。
你说需要自己的空间，我就没有派人找你。我希望今天这场谈话，也是你自己愿意的。

beats.place: 基金会董事会 · 稍后

beats: 以前我用钱让人闭嘴。到此为止。
我们需要紧急过桥资金，也需要保护证人。那个被抹去的第二签名可能就是证人留下的。
但丁看着你，不是请求你允许他自救，而是想知道你是否发现了大家漏掉的办法。
你是从家族外面看这件事的。我漏掉了什么？
琼的学费周五到期。埃琳娜摆出三份方案，每一份都有风险。
可以建立由居民监管的托管账户。这能争取时间，但意味着但丁要放弃签字权。
很好。过去我手里的权力本来就比我懂得使用的多。
资金在审核期间冻结。琼在门外等待，紧张地扯着书包带。
我能保证问题没解决前不会消失，但不能承诺一夜之间就有奇迹。
董事会门口，一位住户代表拒绝把自己的发言时间让给 Dante。
你出钱建了楼，但里面住的人不是你的财产。
Salvatore 的律师放下一份新方案：保留 Moretti 品牌、私下和解、港口项目照常推进。
这里还有保密条款，会让被驱逐的住户无法互相核对经历。
你把最后一段读出声。Dante 将文件扣在桌上。
不行。如果和平的代价是让所有人闭嘴，这就不是和平。

opts.t: 删除禁止住户发声的条款。
then: 委员会收到一份允许公开讨论的新文件。

opts.t: 要求住户独立董事席位。
then: Elena 起草一份不依赖 Dante 是否继续掌权的章程修正案。

opts.t: 暂停表决，先做法律审查。
then: 表决被推迟，没有人被迫拿安全换效率。

beats.place: 深入场景：The first person to say no

beats: 基金会董事会紧急表决 Salvatore 的和解方案。可居民还没拿到文件，票就快数完了。
他们要我签字证明学生已被征询意见。可我连文件都没看过。
Elena 阻止秘书提交会议记录。Dante 本可直接命令董事会重投，但他让 June 亲自说明程序为什么无效。
就算因此丢掉奖学金，我也不会在谎话上签字。
那就换一种办法付学费。你不该被迫做这种交易。
居民获得了公开监督下的第二次表决。结果第一次有可能违背 Dante 的意愿，而他似乎准备好了接受。

choices.t: 提议设立独立的奖学金应急基金。
then: 埃琳娜起草方案；但丁放弃对新基金的控制权。

choices.t: 要求立刻公开账目。
then: 董事会大乱，但证据再也无法悄悄消失。

choices.t: 先寻找被抹去的第二签名者。
then: 你和埃琳娜追踪到一家闲置游艇码头的工资账户。

zh.title: 没有摄像头的房间

goal.zh: First intimacy must be invited and consent-based.
goal.en: First intimacy must be invited and consent-based.

then: 住户得以互相核对新协议，因为禁止讨论的条款已被删除。
董事会加入独立住户代表，Dante 不能单方面否决这个席位。
暂停表决给了法律审查时间，又发现两处有问题的土地转让条款。

beats: 漫长的一天结束，但丁问你愿不愿意找个安静地方待十分钟。他带你去母亲留下的屋顶温室。没有摄像头，没有员工，也没有天鹅绒围绳。
我母亲在这里种罗勒，因为它经得起我疏忽。
他蹲下来给植物换盆。伟大的但丁·莫雷蒂指甲里沾满泥土。
你第一次拒绝我的时候，我以为自己生气了。其实没有。我松了口气，因为你相信自己有权拒绝我。

then: 紧急奖学金现在有独立董事会。是你的建议改变了钱由谁来管。
账目公开了，包括我自己的律师最不想让人看见的数字。
伊莲娜找到了被抹掉的第二个签名。我们终于能证明是谁批准转账。

beats: 雨点敲着玻璃。他走到你身边，却留出清楚的距离。
我想吻你。你拒绝我也能接受。但我不能继续假装自己一点也不想问。
他等着。连雨声都像慢了下来。
温室里有泥土和迷迭香的气味。但丁把手机放进你看得见的抽屉。
我母亲说，这是唯一允许植物不听我命令的房间。
你发现他少年时的一张旧照片：抱着歪掉的花盆，笑得毫无防备。
那个人还在我身体里某个地方。我想你总比我先遇见他。
他想吻你，却把决定完全交给你。不论你怎么回答，他都留下来听你说话。

then: 但丁想牵你的手，却想起你之前说过的边界。他停下来，直到你主动伸出手。
监视争执后，你们隔开了几天。再见面时，没有精心安排，只有一点不自在和诚实。
我没有派人跟着你。我很想你。这是两回事。
文斯带来了你要求的独立安保审计。报告记录了已删除的定位日志，以及必须明确同意才能启动保护措施的新规定。
有签字、有日期，也有独立审核。你可以逐行检查。

beats: 客厅安静下来。Dante 关闭智能音箱，把它们的罩子收进抽屉。电源线也清清楚楚地拔掉了。
我想至少有一个地方，我们能说话，而不用担心被我的世界监听。
你亲口说出自己的想法——“隐私和隐瞒不是一回事。”
我知道。如果这场谈话改变了影响别人的决定，我们仍然要向他们交代。
你发现一本他母亲留下的菜谱，书页沾着柠檬汁和面粉。
她几乎在每个食谱旁都写着‘别着急’。我这一辈子都没怎么听。

beats.hint: 现在怎样的亲近让你舒服？

opts.t: 和他一起做饭，边做边聊。
then: 他穿上围裙，食谱由你选。一口烧糊的锅成了你们的私人笑话。

opts.t: 主动问他愿不愿意牵手。
then: 他轻声说愿意，等你自己靠近。

opts.t: 告诉他今晚需要情感空间。
then: Dante 换了把椅子，认真听你说，没有把你的距离理解成惩罚。

beats.place: 深入场景：The question before the kiss

beats: 雨敲在温室玻璃顶上。Dante 把一盆罗勒放在你们中间，反而向后靠了靠。
我能不能说出我的愿望，而不让你负责实现它？
你点头，或说不想听。他等到真正的回答。
我希望你难过时愿意找我；也希望你说‘今天不想见’时，不需要担心后果。
他剪下一枝长歪的罗勒送给你，笑说自己的园艺技术不值得炫耀，而不是借花暗示占有。
无论今晚有没有亲吻，温室的门都敞着，关于隐私的争议已经按你的条件处理，而他记住了温柔和理所当然之间的区别。

choices.t: 如果你愿意，主动吻他。
then: @他温柔地迎上来，呼吸乱了一瞬

choices.t: 让他先牵你的手。
then: 他的手很暖，竟然微微发抖。他笑得像这一刻比整个帝国都重要。

choices.t: 告诉他你还没准备好。
then: “谢谢你告诉我。”他换了话题，问你最喜欢什么植物。

zh.title: 那个还活着的证人

goal.zh: Reveal missing brother alive and reject ownership disguised as love.
goal.en: Reveal missing brother alive and reject ownership disguised as love.

then: 你们共同尝试的食谱沾上了面粉。Dante 说烧糊的锅比任何晚宴都值得记住。
Dante 记得那次牵手来自彼此同意，而不代表以后什么都默认可以。
Dante 遵守你要求的距离，先问今天是否适合继续谈心。

beats: 第二个签名属于诺拉·贝尔，卢卡生前的助理。她改名生活多年，只有在能自己决定条件的情况下才愿意开口。
我看到卢卡活着离开了九号码头。是我帮他逃出去的。
他怕你把他拖回家族。他离开是因为害怕你，不是因为不再爱你。
但丁的表情像脚下的地板突然错了位。

then: 我记得那个吻。但它从来不意味着你答应了之后所有的事。
那天能牵着你的手，我就已经很开心。今晚也是，你觉得舒服就好。
你说还没有准备好，我听见了。我不会把尊重当成换取吻的筹码。

beats.place: 新泽西游艇码头 · 稍后

beats: 萨尔瓦托雷花钱散播卢卡的死讯。他要但丁又愧疚又听话。
前提是没人逼他。他现在经营一家海洋维修工坊。这是他第一次自己选择的人生。
我想见他。但我没有资格要求。
诺拉把封好的信封放到自己和埃琳娜之间，手在抖，声音却很稳。
我把这些交给你们，必须保证我的现住址绝不进入家族档案。
原件由独立律师保管。是否作证，你随时可以重新决定。
我不需要卢卡的地址。只要告诉他，如果愿意，他永远有一扇门可以打开。
诺拉端详了他许久，终于展开一张照片：卢卡站在一艘修好的蓝色渔船旁。
Nora 从 Elena 办公室正门走进来。她坚持按自己的方式公开出现。
我消失不是为了制造谜团。有人用我的签名开了我根本没见过的账户。
你随时可以终止谈话。这里没人有权向你许诺自己无法保证的豁免。
Nora 看着 Dante：“你弟弟曾试图警告我。他怕你知道后会带着枪来解决问题。”
Dante 吞咽了一下：“如果说的是以前的我，他的担心并非毫无道理。”
屋里静了下来，没有任何人抢走 Nora 把话说完的机会。

beats.hint: 你准备怎样支持 Nora 作证？

opts.t: 交给 Elena 主导，逐条记录证据。
then: Nora 同意由律师主导陈述，事先确定需要隐去的信息。

opts.t: 先问 Nora 想要什么保护，而非 Dante 能提供什么。
then: Nora 要求由独立非营利组织管理的搬迁资金。

opts.t: 主动退出房间，让 Nora 不必面对 Moretti 家族。
then: Dante 也走出去，Nora 得以更自在地对 Elena 说出细节。

beats.place: 深入场景：A witness with her own voice

beats: Nora 与 Elena 约在一家面朝大街的会议室。她拒绝 Vince 最初预订的私人包间。
六年来我都在听有权势的男人解释为什么我必须被藏起来。我想坐在靠门的桌边。
Elena 让她自己选择录音设备、见证律师，以及今天不想回答的问题。Dante 在楼下等待，没有打听她住在哪里。
Luca 没有偷钱。他复制账本，是因为他觉得普通人有权知道谁拥有这片海岸。
她的生活不只有案子。她曾经想当老师，你问她现在是否还想。
也许案子结束以后吧。我差点忘了别人可以问我这个。

choices.t: 支持先写一封由卢卡决定是否回复的信。
then: 但丁写了三份草稿，最后只留下六行真诚的话。

choices.t: 先保护诺拉的证词。
then: 诺拉选择独立律师，并保有对证词的决定权。

choices.t: 问但丁如果卢卡拒绝见面怎么办。
then: “那我就在远处爱他。我想我终于学会了。”

zh.title: 最后的交易

goal.zh: Expose antagonist through civic mechanisms, no vigilante resolution.
goal.en: Expose antagonist through civic mechanisms, no vigilante resolution.

then: Nora 重新检查删隐后的证词，Elena 没催促她签名。
搬迁资金按 Nora 的要求，由 Moretti 公司体系之外的机构管理。
Dante 不在场时，Nora 说得更自在，补充了家族原本不知道的细节。

beats: 市政府举行河滨重建紧急听证会。萨尔瓦托雷带着律师出现，扬言用诉讼拖垮基金会。
但丁只要签和解书，就能保住河滨项目和那个女人。
你还是把人当成财产在谈。
和解书剥夺了居民审查土地转让的权利。
你身后坐着一些家庭，他们的房子可能因重建而被拆除。

then: 卢卡还没回信。写不写、什么时候写，都应该由他自己决定。
诺拉现在有独立律师，也有安全的作证方式。我们不需要知道她藏在哪里。
如果我弟弟永远不回来，我也会继续修复这座城市。他不欠我什么。

beats: 我们拒绝和解，公开记录，让公众审查项目。
他把麦克风推向你，却没有替你打开。你可以发言，也可以沉默。
剩余证据把萨尔瓦托雷的空壳公司和每一次转款联系起来，足够申请禁令。
你发现但丁在等，不是等你批准他的决定，而是等你做自己的决定。
和解协议只给三分之一被迫搬迁的家庭安排住所，其余家庭根本没列入。
一位名叫阿尔瓦雷斯太太的居民站在走廊里，拿着几十年前签的租约。
我以前把这片街区叫作资产。阿尔瓦雷斯太太叫它家。她的词更准确。
你要为几个租户丢掉整个帝国？
不。我只是不肯让这个帝国丢掉他们。

then: 但丁带来了卢卡尚未公开的信，却没有擅自交给你。那是卢卡自己的故事，不是家族产业。
该由他决定，什么时候让别人知道。
伊莲娜确认诺拉的地址从未出现在共享案卷中，她可以安全决定是否作证。
真正的保护，是让她仍有选择权。
家族律师追问卢卡是否要出庭。你提醒他，下落不明不等于有义务作证。
她说得对。我们另找办法证明这件事。

beats: 三份银行转账签名、一份被篡改的董事会纪要和一串无法再抹掉的纸面记录。
Salvatore 授权了空壳公司。原始批准文件在修改前被扫描存档。
门禁记录显示了夜间进出人员，不能单独证明动机，但能支持 Nora 的时间线。
那就交给有关部门，让证据说话。不进行私下报复。
你通过 Elena 保护的联系渠道收到一条短讯：LUCA 安全，但还没准备好见面。
Dante 只读了一遍：“我希望他准备好了。但那不是我能替他决定的。”

opts.t: 把原始证据交给检方留存。
then: Elena 取得证据移交记录，确保每一步都能追溯。

opts.t: 先保护 Nora 免受媒体曝光。
then: 新闻声明按 Nora 的要求隐去她的身份。

opts.t: 提醒 Dante 不要催 Luca 回家。
then: 我听见了。如果你需要我，我会在。

beats.place: 深入场景：The page no one can sign away

beats: 开庭前，Alvarez 太太抱来一盒旧租金收据。Salvatore 的律师称这些纸片与案情无关。
它们证明，在任何人把土地当成投资机会之前，已经有人在这里生活。
Dante 读到一张日期和他出生年份相同的收据。他从小以为海岸属于自己的家族，这张纸却说明了另一件事。
记者追问他是不是为某个女人牺牲财产。Dante 没有看你寻求认可。
不是。我在纠正本不该发生的伤害。她帮助我看清，但伤害不因此变成我们的爱情故事。
听证会重新开始时，你自己选座位。是否坐在他身边，取决于你的意愿。

choices.t: 征得居民同意后替他们发言。
then: 你的发言把重点放在居民的居住权上，而非但丁的形象。

choices.t: 通过埃琳娜提交证据。
then: 听证会将账本纳入公开记录。

choices.t: 拒绝成为他的公众形象代言人。
then: 你不欠我的救赎一张脸。

zh.title: 权力的代价

goal.zh: Crown is abdicated, commitment follows character not power.
goal.en: Crown is abdicated, commitment follows character not power.

then: 证据移交给检方时附带记录，每件材料都能核对是否被篡改。
公开公告依 Nora 的明确要求隐去她的名字。
Dante 给 Luca 发了一条不要求回复的短信，之后也确实没有催促。

beats: 萨尔瓦托雷申请禁令失败。董事会投票暂停他的职务等待调查，但几位投资人要求但丁切断与基金会的关系以保利润。
放弃河滨项目，你可能失去董事长职位。
那就失去。城市不是莫雷蒂家族的。
他把应急奖学金基金的管理权交给独立董事会。
很多年里，我把椅子上的权力误当成了坐在椅子上的人。

then: 居民们希望你再次发言，因为他们记得你上次先听完他们的话。
伊莲娜已经按你的授权提交证据。听证会不再是我家族关起门来的争吵。
宣传海报不会用你的脸。你拒绝成为我改头换面的招牌，我已经叫他们尊重。

beats.place: 莫雷蒂集团总部 · 稍后

beats: 空荡的董事会会议室里，但丁摘下手表，放在尚未签字的辞呈旁。
我不会因为自己开始改变就要求你留下。改变是我欠被我伤害过的人的。
但我想认真问一句：如果没有姓氏、没有钱、没有危险——你还愿意认识我吗？
没有人在门外等待，办公室忽然变得不同。它终于像一间两个成年人都能自己做决定的房间。
投票结束后记者围在楼下。但丁选择走员工电梯，又和坏脾气的咖啡机斗争了三次。
我今天早上辞去了董事长职务，世界没毁灭。看来只有咖啡毁灭了。
他递来一个纸杯，上面歪歪扭扭写着：如果你想要，它就是你的。
我想重新建立一家账本敢在阳光下打开的企业。那得花好多年。
他看起来很累，并不像英雄。你第一次能想象和他度过一个平凡星期二的样子。
独立审计员带来一张清单：必须出售或交由独立机构监督的企业。
你可以保留个人财富，但不能暗中继续控制土地信托，还称它为独立机构。
那就撤掉我的控制权。公布时间表。
Salvatore 的律师最后一次提出私下和解：只要 Dante 撤诉，就保全家族名声。
Dante 没打开文件，直接推了回去。
我不能拿别人的未来给自己的名誉买单。
他看向你，却没有要求你为他鼓掌。

beats.hint: 你认为公开担责必须包括什么？

then: 审计员拟定公开报告日程，不再需要 Dante 每次批准。

opts.t: 赔偿方案由住户共同决定。
then: 住户委员会选出自己的谈判代表，和解条款可以复核。

opts.t: 问 Dante 失去帝国以后想过怎样的生活。
then: 做一份不会让别人害怕说‘不’的工作。

beats.place: 深入场景：What resignation does not fix

beats: June 从奖学金办公室打电话来。资金虽然交给了独立受托人，但第一笔款还是要延后一周。
你们一直说事情在变好。可我的学费最后期限没有往后推。
Dante 没让她耐心等待，而是联系 Elena 和银行合规部门，通过居民非营利组织建立公开条款的临时过桥资金。
辞职只是一种表态。学生拿到学费，才是实际工作。
他回空办公室收拾书，问你要不要帮忙。你说自己还有工作，他答应得很自然。
未来并不是一场壮烈牺牲，而是反复履行那些麻烦又具体的承诺。

choices.t: 告诉他你在意的是人，而不是头衔。
then: “那我会努力成为一个值得认识的人。”

choices.t: 问他现实中一起生活会怎样。
then: 你们认真谈工作、时间、安全、隐私，以及谁都有权说不。

choices.t: 告诉他你还不能决定。
then: “很公平。你的心不需要截止日期。”

zh.title: 他买不到的生活

goal.zh: Show sustainable affection in everyday life.
goal.en: Show sustainable affection in everyday life.

then: 独立审计员公布第一份监督日程，即使 Dante 离职也将继续执行。
住户选出的谈判代表发布了通俗易懂的和解摘要。
Dante 开始寻找一份靠能力而不是靠姓氏赢得尊重的工作。

beats: 董事会投票后，但丁问能不能看看你普通的周六。不包场餐厅，不请造型师，不带司机。只是你原本就有的生活。
他在你厨房里烤糊了面包，没有怪罪烤面包机，还认真问你喜欢咖啡怎么喝。
你可以笑。别人犯这么小的错我都放过狠话，但这片面包赢得堂堂正正。
门铃响起。快递送来一个小信封，上面的笔迹很熟悉：卢卡。
介意我在这里看吗？我不想忽然把你丢在一边。

then: 我这一生都在保护莫雷蒂这个姓，可你看见的是姓氏下面的那个人。我不想辜负这件事。
我问玛拉能不能教我不用助理做饭。她笑着甩给我一张购物清单。
我不会给你的感情定期限。我可以耐心等，也会继续过好自己的生活。

beats.place: 普通街区公寓 · 稍后

beats: 我很安全。我还需要时间。我看到了你为河滨社区做的事。
但丁闭上眼。他没有逼你替他解释信的含义。
他不必回来。知道他能够自己选择，就已经足够。
他伸手想牵你，却在半途停住。就算是温柔的时刻，你的意愿仍然重要。
街角市场里，但丁根本不知道番茄多少钱。收银员认出了你，先向你打招呼。
我这辈子买蔬菜都多付钱。这算不算丑闻？
邻居问他是不是来帮你搬家。但丁等着你按自己喜欢的方式介绍他。
我能帮你拎袋子，也能学会在你只想一个人过下午时安静离开。
回到家，卢卡寄来的信没有回邮地址。这份隐私倒像礼物。
超市明亮、拥挤，根本不在乎 Dante Moretti 是谁。一位阿姨叫他把购物车挪开。
你忍不住笑。他看起来反而很高兴，只是面对一整排意面有些手足无措。
我知道怎么买下一家连锁餐厅，却完全不知道你做酱汁要哪种番茄。
结账时，收银员认出了你，感谢你帮助滨水区公布了相关记录。
我姨妈保住了公寓。那才是最重要的。
Dante 没有插话。难得有一次，他很满足于当那个帮忙提袋子的人。

beats.hint: 你想选择怎样的普通一天？

opts.t: 如果你愿意，邀请他到你家做晚饭。
then: 他先问需要带什么，并按你定的时间到。
他祝你下午愉快，没有突然出现。

opts.t: 请 Mara 和 Elena 一起吃饭。
then: 这顿饭聊的是菜谱和助学金，而不是你们的恋情。

beats.place: 深入场景：The price of tomatoes

beats: 在市场里 Dante 连续两次拿错香草，只好问补货的少年怎么区分。他听得格外认真。
我学过的所有金融知识，都没教我如何认香菜。
你下午还有预约。他先问你几点想分开，而不是找借口赖着不走。
港口居民委员会的一位女士认出你，感谢你坚持公开听证。Dante 自觉站远，让这段对话不必有他参与。
我喜欢他们认识你，却不需要认识我。我觉得本来就该这样。
你愿意自己拿购物袋，就自己拿。他不再问你需不需要被拯救，而是开始问你真正需要什么。

choices.t: 牵住他的手，约一次普通约会。
then: 他提议一起去菜市场，认真记住你喜欢什么水果。

choices.t: 谈谈各自工作与私人空间。
then: 你们约定双方都不用把自己完全融进对方的世界。

choices.t: 今天就当朋友一起过。
then: 但丁接受“朋友”这个称呼，没有试着讨价还价。

zh.title: 他终于认真问出的那句话

goal.zh: Meaningful non-punitive relationship commitment choice.
goal.en: Meaningful non-punitive relationship commitment choice.

then: 你邀请的晚饭没有员工，也没有摄像头。Dante 按时提着食材来了。
你一个人逛书店。没人不请自来，Dante 也没要求你汇报下午的行踪。
餐盘收走很久后，Mara 和 Elena 还在聊奖学金预算。

beats: 听证会暂时告一段落。基金会转入独立管理。卢卡平安。几个月后，但丁邀请你去最初那座俯瞰全城的天台。
刚认识时，我以为权力意味着永远听不到拒绝。你让我知道，真正的力量是听得进去。
你们之间没有昂贵的首饰盒，没有镜头。只有长椅、天际线和两杯外带咖啡。
我爱你。你不一定要回应。我只想让你知道——这句话不附带交易。

then: 玛拉把桌子留好了。不摆安保阵势，也没有镜头。今晚就吃顿饭，聊你想聊的事。
你的工作有了自己的资金和办公室。能彼此选择，却不必把两个人生合成一份，我很喜欢。
那天我们作为朋友度过的下午很重要。我不会因为今晚问你一个新问题，就抹掉它。

beats: 他深呼吸，终于问出那个一直没敢变成命令的问题。
你真正想要怎样的未来？和我在一起，不和我在一起，或介于两者之间？
远处传来列车声。没有任何东西挡住你的选择。
无论你怎么决定，我都不会让你为诚实付出代价。
天台上，他在咖啡旁放下一本小笔记，里面记着你自愿告诉他的喜好与重要日子。
我知道你喝什么咖啡，也知道哪些话题你不想谈。但我仍不知道你今晚会怎么决定。
你看到一页空白纸，标题写着：还有很多事没来得及问。
我想要一种生活：永远不停止好奇你是什么样的人。但你不是对我变好的一份奖赏。
曼哈顿的灯光在身后静静闪烁；一个再大的权力也不能替你回答的问题摆在面前。

then: 但丁没有安排顶层公寓派对，而是在玛拉的小餐厅订了桌。他没有带随从，只带着你推荐的一本书。
这是我一直希望你看见的生活。
你的事业已经成为码头重建项目不可忽略的一部分。但丁公开感谢你，没有把功劳算在自己头上。
你独立做成的事，我真的很骄傲。
你们一起度过了一个没有恋爱压力的下午。即使季终临近，他也尊重友谊这条可能的路。
就算我们最后只是朋友，对我来说也很重要。

beats: 楼顶的风掀起 Dante 的笔记本。一张空白页上只写着：怎样的生活才会让你觉得自由？
我的心意已经说清楚了。现在我想知道，你的愿意或不愿意，对你意味着什么？
你亲口说出自己的想法——“即使答应，我也有事业、朋友、隐私和自己的空间。”
当然。爱不能意味着不顾你的意愿把生活合并。
他静静等着，不再预演答案。
无论发生什么，我希望你在自己的未来里仍然认得出自己。

beats.hint: 什么底线会定义你的未来？

then: Dante 不讨价还价，直接同意。

opts.t: 我还没准备好定义关系。
then: 那今晚就不写任何条款。

beats.place: 深入场景：A promise that is not a proposal

beats: Dante 在公园长椅等你，没有戒指、摄影师或排练好的宣言，手里只有第一笔公开拨付的奖学金收据。
我以前以为请求一个人留下，需要特别壮观的理由。今天只带了这张纸，证明我至少学会把不浪漫的事做完。
你们谈起那些无论有没有他都会存在的生活：事业、朋友、你亲手建立的城市地图。
如果我们选择在一起，它们还在；如果没有，它们也一样属于你。
他的告白轻得几乎听不见。这里容得下坚定的爱、谨慎的可能，也容得下清楚的拒绝。他的表情会改变，尊重却不会。

choices.t: 选择平等而认真的恋爱关系。
then: “那我们一起建一个谁都不需要逃走的未来。”

choices.t: 选择慢慢相爱，暂不约定独占关系。
then: “那就继续认识彼此。不擅自假设，不着急。”

choices.t: 选择友情，或暂时独自生活。
then: 谢谢你告诉我真话。我会尊重。

zh.title: 新闻之后的人生

goal.zh: Epilogue and living-world entry.
goal.en: Epilogue and living-world entry.

then: 你们对未来的约定里明确禁止追踪，不会因为恋爱身份而失效。
楼顶谈话以后，你的日程仍归自己，Dante 不会默认共享。
你选择暂不定义关系，Dante 因而更谨慎地询问，而不是擅自假定。

beats: 楼顶谈话六个月后，九号码头旁的旧仓库变成了社区花园和工坊。获得奖学金的学生在这里办公开展览。
设计方案由居民自己投票决定。基金会现在向社区负责。
但丁抱着折叠椅过来，一脸被说明书冒犯的表情。
我能谈妥航运公司的未来。为什么这里有七颗螺丝，却只有六个孔？
大家都笑了，包括他自己。

then: 我们决定认真在一起。我记得你答应时有多慎重，所以我想用每个普通的日子好好回应你。
我知道我们还没有约定独占关系。谢谢你告诉我自己舒服的节奏。我不会催你。
你的决定我听进去了，也会尊重。这间社区中心同样属于你。你从来不需要爱我，才能在这里拥有自己的位置。

beats: 后来在河边，但丁递给你一张小照片：社区第一届毕业典礼。背面写着日期，以及“我们守住了承诺”。
我不能保证再也不会害怕。但我能保证，害怕时会告诉你，也会听你说。
新一届城市节庆、埃琳娜的消息，以及但丁邀请你下周五吃一顿普通晚餐的未读信息。
我们后面的故事不是新闻标题。是明天我们愿意一起选择的生活。
琼介绍第一届奖学金毕业生；玛拉把柠檬蛋糕放在纸盘上；埃琳娜逼每个人签志愿者登记表。
我扛过董事会投票、联邦审计和我叔父，但没一个比拿夹板的埃琳娜更严格。
那就别争了，赶紧签字。你也要像其他人一样来种树。
滨水区不再挂着莫雷蒂家族徽章。它属于真正生活在这里的人。
无论现在我们是什么关系，你都让这个地方真正活了过来。这件事永远重要。

then: 庆典结束后的几周里，但丁把每周五的晚上空出来。不是为了董事会，而是为了你。
你答应继续了解我，不代表给了我一张无限期的空白支票。
你们走进社区厨房，志愿者正为毕业晚餐做准备。但丁进门时没有人起立——他反而最喜欢这一点。
你俩可以切洋葱，也可以出去。别站这儿光顾着好看。
洋葱我会切。可能会哭。请别把这写成新闻标题。
晚些时候，他把两把钥匙放在桌上。一把是他的公寓，另一把是温室备用钥匙。
这是邀请，不是要求。你可以拿一把、两把，或者都不要。我们慢慢决定家意味着什么。
双方商定独占关系，保留个人事业和边界，可选同住，每周五约会，不进行未经同意的监控。卢卡的人生始终由卢卡决定。
庆典后的几周里，但丁仍然会在安排约会前询问。某些星期你答应，某些星期你拒绝。两种答案都真实有效。
以前我会直接派车。现在我只发一条消息：‘想一起吃晚餐吗？’我发现我更喜欢真正的回答。
你们坐在玛拉的小餐馆里，还算不上正式恋人，但也不再陌生。他记住了你最喜欢的座位，却没有把那个位置当成自己的权利。
听着，再慢慢了解一年也不会发生什么灾难。
这就是计划。或者不是。我们可以慢慢发现。
他把最后一块柠檬挞让给你，你说想一起分着吃，他便把盘子拉回两人中间。这只是一场平凡的小协商，却让双方都很开心。
在双方明确商定前不默认独占，不因嫉妒惩罚用户，不自动进入婚姻，双方保持自主生活。
庆典后的几周里，社区中心正式开门，墙上已经没有莫雷蒂家族的名字。居民邀请你来，因为记得你做过什么，而不是因为你和谁在一起。
你根本不需要成为他故事的一部分，才能改变这里。
但丁抱着折叠椅出现。他在庭院另一端看见你，停在合适距离，微笑。
看见你过得好，我很高兴。不发表演说，我保证。
你可以与他友好地喝杯咖啡，也可以挥挥手，或者直接走向展厅。没有人跟着你。
慢慢地，新闻开始用你自己的名字称呼你。
关系保持你选择的友情或距离。独立事业和朋友仍可继续游玩。除非玩家主动重启恋爱话题，但丁不会再次追求。

beats: 社区庆典后的第二天，花园要浇水，工具房钥匙又不知被谁弄丢。生活不会因为头条而停止。
住户选出了监督委员会。June 准备竞选学生席位。
还有人要给志愿者送柠檬蛋糕。别什么都指望我。
Dante 没擅自安排你的时间，先问：“今天你想做什么？”
已经不需要盛大的宣言。未来由普通选择组成，有些一起做，有些各自完成。
城市仍然吵闹，但你的人生可以安静下来。

then: 不论你们是什么关系，Dante 都祝你顺利。
June 请你审阅学生发起的方案。
你们约定一个彼此方便的时间。

beats.place: 深入场景：After the cameras leave

beats: 社区中心重新开门时，有志愿者挂出一块“拯救港口的英雄”展牌。June 当即请他撤下。
从来没有一个英雄。这里有租户、律师、教师、志愿者，还有十几个不愿上镜的人。
Dante 没有争论，帮忙把旧牌搬出去。新牌写着：“留下来的人们”。
Elena 问你是否愿意把自己的名字写进公共档案。你可以署名、匿名，或暂不公开。
这一次，未来不会由亿万富翁、犯罪家族或记者替你写好答案。决定权属于你，也属于你自己选择留在身边的人。

choices.t: 参与策划下一项社区计划。
then: 他笑着问，你希望把哪件平凡小事变成两人的专属习惯。

choices.t: 为下个月挑选一个小习惯。
then: 他提出每周五一起吃饭的邀约，而你每次都可以拒绝。

choices.t: 在下一季前给自己一段平静假期。
then: 但丁祝你顺利。这个社区仍然欢迎你来，不必由他陪同。

en.title: The Only Woman Who Said No

goal.zh: Establish consent and why Dante is interested, without coercion.
goal.en: Establish consent and why Dante is interested, without coercion.

beats: New York, 10:47 p.m. Twenty executives go silent when the elevator opens. You have never seen a room surrender so fast.
Dante Moretti crosses the room in a black suit, then stops an arm’s length away. The man who owns half the city looks almost unsure.
You came. I rehearsed a better opening. Apparently I forgot it.
Can I take your coat? Or should I keep my hands to myself?
The city shines beneath the windows. On the table sits a small paper bag from the neighborhood bakery you mentioned once, three nights ago.
It’s not a gift you have to accept. I just remembered you said their lemon cake was sold out.
He places an elevator card by your hand, not into it.
Your exit, whenever you want it. Now—would you let me ask you to dinner?
The bakery bag has your name written on it—not the name you gave his assistant, but the name you used when you met at the community fundraiser.
I remembered. You looked annoyed when everyone else called you the wrong thing.
He moves the chair out for you and sits only after you choose your seat.
You can tell me no tonight. You can tell me no tomorrow. I will still mean the compliment when I say you look incredible.
For a man who can purchase silence, he seems determined to earn an answer.

beats.place: The elevator still has a door

beats: Dante notices that you have not taken the seat he offered. For the first time tonight, he stops trying to look impressive.
We can start again. Hi. I'm Dante. I am very bad at asking people for things I cannot buy.
You answer in your own words—"And what exactly do you want from me?"
One honest hour. If it's terrible, I'll be the one to call your cab.
Vince steps forward with a folder. Dante raises one finger without turning toward him.
Not now. She gets an evening, not a briefing.
Dante places his own phone in a drawer and leaves the drawer unlocked.
See? I'm trying the radical experiment of paying attention.

beats.hint: How do you set the pace?

opts.t: Ask him to tell one embarrassing story.
then: Dante laughs and admits he once burned a birthday cake while following a video tutorial.

opts.t: Ask for one rule: no interruptions.
then: He asks Vince to handle everything that can wait. He does not make a performance of it.

opts.t: Keep the conversation brief, but genuine.
then: Dante checks the clock once, then turns it facedown so you do not have to.

beats.place: The one request he cannot purchase

beats: Vince waits by the study door with the canceled Geneva briefing. Dante does not look at it until you ask whether the people on that call could be hurt by his decision.
That's a better question than whether I can afford to cancel. There are people who prepared for that meeting. I owe them an explanation.
He sends a short apology and asks Vince to reschedule with their consent. No grand announcement, no show of power. Then he turns the phone screen facedown.
I wanted you to see me choose you. I may have forgotten other people's time matters too.
You watch him absorb the correction instead of turning it into a compliment. For the first time tonight, his attention feels less like a spotlight and more like a place where you can breathe.
I don't want you impressed into silence. If I get something wrong, tell me.

choices.t: Tease him: “The mafia king gets nervous?
then: He laughs, relieved. 'Only around you. It’s inconvenient.'

choices.t: Offer him your coat.
then: He handles it as though trust were something fragile. 'Thank you.'

choices.t: Ask why he canceled the meeting.
then: 'Because you didn’t agree to be an interruption. I chose to make time.'

en.title: A Table for Two

goal.zh: Make intimacy reciprocal and plant the first external danger.
goal.en: Make intimacy reciprocal and plant the first external danger.

then: At the next date, Dante offers the story of his disastrous cake before you ask. The teasing is becoming mutual.
The restaurant is quiet. Dante has told Vince not to call unless someone is in immediate danger.
Dante keeps dinner to the hour you agreed. When time is up, he asks if you would like to leave.

beats: He does not take you to a rooftop full of cameras. He takes you to a tiny restaurant with eight tables, handwritten menus, and a bell above the door.
Dante? You have not eaten here since your mother—
I know. Mara, this is my guest. Please treat her like any other customer.
The older owner gives you a conspiratorial smile. Dante pulls out a chair, then waits until you decide where to sit.
I come here when I want to remember the version of me who had nothing to sell.

then: For the record, I am still nervous. You made it worse in the best way.
You trusted me with a coat. I do not take small trust lightly.
You asked for honesty yesterday. I brought the full answer, not a polished version.

beats: Between courses, his phone lights up: VINCE — URGENT. Dante turns it face down.
I can take one call if you want the truth about my life. Or I can spend one dinner actually listening. Your choice.
Outside, a black sedan slows by the window. Dante notices it; he does not make you notice.
Tell me one thing people keep assuming about you—and getting wrong.
He used to come here with his mother. They fought over the last lemon tart every Sunday.
She always won. I believe the word is parenting.
Your laugh surprises him. He sets down his fork as if he wants to remember the sound.
I don’t know what you expect from me. I’d rather you tell me than let me guess and get it wrong.
Then start with a second date, Dante. A request. Not an acquisition.
Mara puts down the check before either of you asks. Beneath the total she has written: NEXT TIME, COME AS PEOPLE.
I knew his mother when all he owned was a terrible leather jacket.
The jacket had a hole. Tell her about the summer you washed dishes here.
Dante looks at you, then at the kitchen door. "I was sixteen. My mother needed help. Nobody needed to call me 'sir.'"
The waiter asks which one of you is paying. Dante keeps his hands on the table.
You decide. This part shouldn't be a test of my bank account.

then: He nods and asks Mara for two receipts. Your boundaries feel normal, not dramatic.

opts.t: Let him treat; choose the next place yourself.
then: Dante agrees immediately. "Deal. But please, somewhere with decent coffee."
He thanks you for dinner and leaves an ordinary tip to Mara, without arguing.

beats: Mara returns with a plate of uneven cannoli and a photograph of Dante at seventeen, covered in flour. Dante's ears go faintly red.
He told every girl he was going to own Manhattan. Could barely keep a dishwasher running.

When the laughter settles, a student at the next table recognizes Elena's name from a community legal clinic. She asks whether the foundation will keep paying scholarships if Moretti investors sell the dockside properties.
Dante doesn't promise what he cannot guarantee. He asks for her application number and offers to connect her directly with the independent administrator.
That is the problem with taking you somewhere real. Real life refuses to stay outside the scene.
You can tell he is embarrassed. You also notice he listens to the student before he reaches for his wallet.

choices.t: Tell him something personal.
then: He remembers every word and offers a piece of his own past in return.

choices.t: Ask about his mother.
then: 'She taught me that feeding someone isn’t the same as owning them.'

choices.t: Tell him to take the call.
then: He steps away for forty seconds, comes back, and tells you exactly why it mattered.

en.title: The Photograph

goal.zh: Establish player agency and paparazzi sabotage.
goal.en: Establish player agency and paparazzi sabotage.

then: Mara brings two separate receipts without comment. The simplest boundary has become ordinary.
Dante asks about the next place you wanted to try, but does not book it for you.
Dante thanks you again for dinner. He has stopped treating money as an argument.

beats: The next morning a photograph lands on every gossip feed: YOU AND THE MORETTI KING. Underneath: PRICELESS HOSTAGE OR NEW QUEEN?
Your phone fills with strangers asking where you work, where you live, and whether you were paid to be seen with him.
I need you to hear this before you hear anything else: I did not release that photograph.
I can have my legal team request takedowns. I cannot erase the fact that it happened.
He sets a folder down. On top is a blank page titled YOUR DECISION.

then: I kept thinking about what you told me at dinner. I will not repeat it to anyone.
Mara says my mother would have liked you. I think she would have asked you to challenge me.
You heard the business call. I owe you the part I did not explain.

beats: Our security people can move her somewhere private.
Only if she asks. And do not call her “her” in a room where she is standing.
Vince apologizes. His jaw tightens when a second image appears: the same sedan from last night.
Someone wants my name attached to yours. We find out why. Together, if you want.
The tabloids got your picture before sunrise. That means someone paid to have a photographer waiting.
I can pay for legal help. Elena answers to you, not to me.
Elena closes the folder until you tell her she may open it.
We can seek a correction and preserve the originals. If you want to say nothing publicly, that’s also a decision.
My name created this storm. Your life does not become my property because I want to protect it.
Elena projects the leaked image onto a plain white wall. Its timestamp is eighteen minutes earlier than the time you left the restaurant.
That is impossible unless the image was queued or somebody changed the metadata.
The sedan was registered to a shell company near Pier Nine. I do not have proof of who ordered it.
Then we do not say we do. Not to the police, not to her.
Your phone buzzes with a message from an unknown number: ASK HIM WHAT HAPPENED TO LUCA.
For a moment, Dante's hand closes around the back of a chair. He lets go before speaking.
That's my brother. He is not a bargaining chip. You can ask, and I will tell you what I know.

then: Elena preserves a copy while keeping your private number out of the case notes.

opts.t: Ask Dante about Luca, in private.
then: Dante admits he has been afraid to say his brother’s name out loud.

opts.t: Demand a pause before making any public statement.
then: Elena stops the press plan. Your silence is not treated as consent to someone else speaking.

beats.place: A name is not a headline

beats: The gossip site publishes a second correction, this time spelling your name wrong. Elena lays both versions beside the original photograph.
They can claim they corrected the story while still turning you into a character. That is why you approve every word.
Dante's first instinct is to demand the publisher's private number. He catches himself before Vince moves.
No. A legal notice. No threats. She already has enough people deciding what her day should look like.
You write the first sentence of your own response, then delete it. Nothing says you must turn your life into a press statement.
There are going to be people who call you brave just for standing next to me. You can tell them to mind their business. I will.

choices.t: Demand a public correction in your own words.
then: 'You write it. I won’t edit your voice.'

choices.t: Ask for privacy help, with boundaries.
then: He orders no tracking, no watchers, and one contact number you can mute.

choices.t: Investigate the car yourself, with his information.
then: He gives you the footage without arguing that you should stay out of it.

en.title: The Man Without a Gun

goal.zh: Show competence, community stakes, and philanthropy compromise.
goal.en: Show competence, community stakes, and philanthropy compromise.

then: Elena has filed the anonymous message as evidence; the police receive a redacted copy without your private number.
Dante finally tells you Luca used to study the waterfront contracts, but he stops before speculating about the disappearance.
The prepared press statement stays in a closed folder. You remain the person who decides when to speak.

beats: You expect Dante to spend the day in private meetings. Instead, you find him on a folding chair in a waterfront community center, trying to repair a broken projector.
Our scholarship students can’t present without it. Mr. Moretti insisted on “helping.
I used to be better at useful things.
He has taken off his jacket. His sleeves are rolled up. He looks younger without his bodyguards.
My mother started the scholarship. I kept funding it because I could. That’s not the same as being good.

then: The statement uses your words. I kept the edits off your desk.
The contact protocol is in writing. No tracking, no surprise visits.
The vehicle footage you requested is authenticated. Your own investigation counts.

beats: A teenager thanks Dante and then asks you whether you are his new public-relations project.
No. She is someone I am trying to know. And she owes me nothing.
Dante, the scholarship accounts have discrepancies. Someone moved money through the foundation.
Show her if she wants to see it. No secrets used as a favor.
A student named June shows you a scholarship letter whose approval signature belongs to someone who retired two years ago.
That is either sloppy administration or a forgery. Neither is something we can ignore.
My family’s name is on this building. I will answer for what happened here, whether I knew or not.
June asks whether the money she needs for school is still coming. Dante looks at Elena before promising anything.
I won’t buy her reassurance with a lie. Elena, let’s find the money and tell her when we actually have it.

beats.place: The names on the scholarship wall

beats: The projector flickers alive. A teenage student named June shows photographs of the harbor before it became a line on an investor's map.
My grandfather worked on that pier. They say the demolition is for 'public good.' Do we get to vote?
Not under the current contract. That's why we're challenging it.
Dante studies a donor plaque bearing the Moretti name. "Then the money has to be separated from the decision-making."
You notice that one of the grant recipients was removed last month without explanation.
If you see a problem in my foundation, say it in front of me. I will not protect a flattering story over a real person.

beats.hint: How do you respond to the missing name?

opts.t: Ask June what the community actually needs.
then: June asks for public records and an independent vote, not another grand donation.

opts.t: Ask Elena to audit the scholarship ledger.
then: Elena finds a payment approved by a trustee nobody on staff recognizes.

opts.t: Confront Dante about his family name on the wall.
then: He says, "If the name makes this place less safe, take it down."

beats: June, a scholarship student, shows you the empty chairs at the back of the community hall.
They put donor names on the front row. The people who actually live here sit where nobody can see them.
Dante stands with a stack of folding chairs in his hands. The moment could make a charming picture, but June has a practical request: move the residents to the front before the hearing begins.
You're right. Vince, can we help rearrange? Only if the organizers agree.
You move nameplates instead of people. A local grandmother takes the front-row seat bearing the Moretti crest and looks satisfied.
My family paid for this room. I think we forgot that doesn't make it ours.
He asks June to speak first. It costs him a moment of applause; you suspect it is the first useful thing he has done all week.

choices.t: Help Elena trace the accounts.
then: Elena becomes an ally; a shell-company name repeats across the records.

choices.t: Stay with the students.
then: Dante watches you make a frightened student laugh. For once he doesn’t have a practiced response.

choices.t: Ask Dante why the foundation is vulnerable.
then: 'Because I assumed my signature meant people were safe. I was wrong.'

en.title: His First Real Apology

goal.zh: Repair after an actual mistake; model consent and accountability.
goal.en: Repair after an actual mistake; model consent and accountability.

then: June forwards the residents’ requests: public records and a real vote. Dante agrees to fund access, not outcomes.
The missing scholarship name is now part of Elena’s independent audit; someone has to explain the deletion.
The Moretti plaque has been removed pending the community vote. The wall looks less impressive, more honest.

beats: A security consultant calls your employer without permission. Your coworker asks whether you are in trouble. You learn the consultant works for Dante.
You go straight to his old office, where he is meeting Vince over maps and photographs.
I asked Vince to keep the people around you safe. I never authorized that call. But it happened on my watch.
It crossed her boundary. Do not justify it.

then: We found two shell-company signatures. You were right to look at the ledger.
June asked whether you would come back. I told her only you can answer that.
I had the audit started. No one gets to hide behind my ignorance now.

beats: He asks Vince to leave. For the first time you see Dante without an audience, without a plan.
I owe you an apology. Not a gift. Not a speech. I am sorry.
I’ll terminate the contract and give you the contact logs. You decide whether you still want me in your life.
His phone buzzes. He ignores it. The silence is harder on him than a threat.
You ask who approved the consultant. Vince shows you a chain of forwarded messages that ends in an automated authorization.
The system classified you as a potential target. It should never have classified you without asking.
Delete the profile. Preserve the audit trail. Let her verify both actions independently.
He does not reach for your hand. For once, his apology takes up more space than his confidence.
If you choose to leave today, I will not show up at your door with flowers and call it romance.
Dante invites you to the library instead of the surveillance office. On the desk is a list of the decisions his security team made without asking you.
I thought a warning justified monitoring. I was wrong. I cannot unmake it. I can tell you exactly what was collected and have Elena oversee its deletion.
Vince sets a sealed envelope down. "Location logs. Names of the staff who accessed them. No copies on my personal devices."
I represent you on this issue, not Dante. You can ask an independent investigator to inspect the system.
You realize apology is not the same as rebuilding trust.
If you leave tonight, I will still cooperate with the audit. That is not something you owe me a reward for.

opts.t: Require written deletion and independent verification.
then: Dante signs the instruction. Elena—not his security team—sets the review date.

opts.t: Ask for time with no contact.
then: He agrees to wait until you reach out. The distance is honored in later scenes.

opts.t: Ask him why control feels safer to him than trust.
then: He admits that losing Luca taught him the wrong lesson: prevent everything, even at a cost to others.

beats: Vince brings a written summary of the unauthorized security check. There are no dramatic excuses in it: who requested the data, who saw it, when it was deleted, who signed the policy revision.
I should have asked. I didn't. It won't happen again.
You point to a line that would allow the company to retain location logs for sixty days. Elena crosses it out and asks for an independent privacy consultant.
You shouldn't need a legal degree to refuse being followed.
For once he says sorry without adding the words 'because I care.' The apology is not a trap that requires forgiveness.
You can be angry and still safe. Those two things are allowed to happen at the same time.
The silence afterward is uncomfortable. He lets it remain uncomfortable.

choices.t: Accept the apology, with one new boundary.
then: He writes it down and repeats it back correctly.

choices.t: Ask for time apart.
then: 'I won’t turn your silence into a challenge. Take the time.'

choices.t: Make him explain Vince’s authority.
then: The answer exposes an oversight weakness Dante must repair.

en.title: The Night of the Broken Window

goal.zh: Introduce physical stakes without glamorizing confinement.
goal.en: Introduce physical stakes without glamorizing confinement.

then: Elena confirms the surveillance deletion was independently checked. Dante does not call it a favor.
Dante has kept the requested silence. Your next encounter happens because you choose it, not because he engineers it.
When the crisis escalates Dante says he can explain his fear without letting it direct your movements.

beats: A charity gallery opening ends when a brick crashes through a rear window. A note follows: MORETTI’S WEAKNESS HAS A FACE.
Dante reaches you before his security team, but stops when you step back.
Are you hurt? Tell me where you want to go.
Nobody saw the person throw it. The cameras were turned off six minutes before.
For the first time, Dante looks afraid in front of people. He does not try to hide it.

then: The consultant contract is terminated. You have the cancellation in writing.
You asked for space. I came only because Elena invited both of us to the public event.
I handed Elena the delegation records. You were right to ask who signed off.

beats: I have enemies. That is my responsibility. You are not a weakness someone gets to exploit.
You notice the note’s paper: thick ivory stationery stamped with an old family crest.
We should close the gallery and move everyone.
Evacuate anyone who chooses to leave. Elena, preserve the footage. And ask her what she wants first.
Two artists are missing from the headcount. The rear stairwell may be blocked.
You point to the loading corridor. Dante immediately asks Vince to send the fire crew there.
Tell me what you need, not what a movie hero would do.
The two artists emerge safely, shaking. One is carrying a canvas instead of a coat.
I used to think fear was useful only when people feared me. Tonight I found out what it feels like from the other side.
A second pane breaks near the gallery entrance. Vince pushes open the service corridor, then stops when you raise a hand.
I need to know whether you consent to the safe exit. You're not under arrest and this is not a locked route.
The police are on their way. We also need to preserve the camera files before somebody wipes the server.
Dante is pale but standing. Blood beads at the edge of his sleeve where glass scratched him.
Don't confuse my fear for an order. Tell me what you want me to do.
At the corridor's end, you glimpse the same distinctive silver sedan from the leaked photograph.
Someone is staging danger to force a very public response.

beats.hint: Where do you direct the response?

opts.t: Leave with Elena and preserve witness names.
then: Elena escorts you to the public police desk, not an undisclosed private safehouse.

opts.t: Request an ambulance for injured guests.
then: Dante follows your lead and tells Vince to assist the paramedics.

opts.t: Ask police to secure the gallery server.
then: A forensic officer recovers a deleted appointment with the name S. MORETTI.

beats: The broken gallery window has been boarded up. A conservator asks whether she should remove a framed watercolor that belongs to the residents' art program.
Leave the art where its owners want it. We can photograph the damage without turning their work into evidence.
Dante holds out his phone, then thinks better of it.
Would a photograph help, or would it make tonight worse?
You are relieved he asks before recording you. When emergency workers finish their report, he offers to walk to the all-night diner rather than take you straight to his penthouse.
No heroic speech. I was frightened, too. I just didn't want you to have to carry my fear.
His hand is unsteady as he reaches for his coffee. You decide whether to notice aloud.

choices.t: Help evacuate the artists.
then: Dante follows your lead. The artists remember who stayed.

choices.t: Study the family crest with Elena.
then: You match it to a dormant Moretti holding company.

choices.t: Leave immediately and demand distance.
then: Dante arranges no escort unless you ask; he gives you the emergency line only.

en.title: The Family Dinner

goal.zh: Connect antagonist to foundation and respect boundaries.
goal.en: Connect antagonist to foundation and respect boundaries.

then: Elena’s exit report puts witness safety first and records the route taken without revealing the location publicly.
The injured guest recovers. At the next meeting, Dante thanks the paramedics before mentioning himself.
The recovered appointment mentioning S. MORETTI gives Elena a concrete lead, not a license for accusations.

beats: Elena invites you to a family dinner to review the forged account signatures. Dante asks separately whether you want to attend. You say yes on your terms.
At the table, Dante’s uncle Salvatore smiles without warmth.
So this is the girl who can make our Dante abandon a board meeting.
She has a name, and she is here because she chose to be.
How modern. Does she know what the Moretti name costs?

then: The artists asked me to thank you for staying with them.
That crest you spotted matches Salvatore’s old stationery.
I remember that you needed distance. You can leave tonight at any time.

beats: Dessert arrives. You recognize the same family crest embossed under Salvatore’s silver cigarette case.
The board has a vote tomorrow. Whoever controls the foundation also controls the waterfront redevelopment project.
Then tomorrow is about the people who live there. Not my reputation.
Romance makes a man sentimental. Sentiment makes him weak.
No. It makes him answerable. There is a difference.
You’re clever. Does Dante pay for cleverness in diamonds or in bank transfers?
The table goes quiet. You are free to answer—or ignore him.
She came to dinner. She did not come to be evaluated by you.
And I came with account statements. Salvatore, why does your holding company appear on student grants?
For the first time, the uncle looks at the doorway before he answers.
The Moretti dining room has silver cutlery older than you. Salvatore watches where you sit before he looks at your face.
Interesting. Dante has always believed the world should move when he asks. Does he believe you will?
You answer in your own words—"Why not ask me? I'm here."
Dante hides a smile behind his glass. Salvatore does not.
The waterfront can be a profitable place for people who understand family.
Elena's notes in your handbag list six tenants facing eviction under a company that has no real office.
You're invited here as my guest. You do not have to play along with anyone's version of 'family.'

opts.t: Ask him directly who profits from the evictions.
then: He refuses to answer. Dante notices how quickly his uncle changes the subject.

opts.t: Keep him talking while Elena checks the papers.
then: Elena confirms the shell company shares a lawyer with Salvatore’s trust.

opts.t: Leave before the dinner becomes a negotiation.
then: Dante follows only to ask whether you want a ride. He does not demand an explanation.

beats.place: The empty chair at the table

beats: Salvatore lifts his glass toward the empty place at the family dinner table.
We still set a seat for Luca. Sentiment is an expensive hobby.
Dante moves the untouched plate out of the camera's line of sight.
Luca isn't a prop for your dinner.
Mara, unexpectedly invited to cook, takes the dish from a startled server and asks you whether you'd prefer to leave. She isn't testing your courage.
There are easier rooms to be in. Leaving this one doesn't make you weak.
You notice that Dante has stopped looking at Salvatore for permission to speak. Instead he studies the guest list: every business ally here stands to gain if the waterfront deal closes.
I used to think loyalty meant sitting through this. I'm beginning to think it means refusing to make someone else sit through it.

choices.t: Challenge Salvatore across the table.
then: His smile fades; Elena later tells you the board noticed your courage.

choices.t: Quietly photograph the matching crest.
then: You collect corroborating evidence without an immediate confrontation.

choices.t: Ask Dante to leave together.
then: He rises before anyone finishes protesting. 'I said she could leave whenever she wanted.'

en.title: Not Your Prisoner

goal.zh: Open the emotional core of Dante’s missing brother.
goal.en: Open the emotional core of Dante’s missing brother.

then: Salvatore avoids your question at dinner. Elena highlights that evasiveness in her timeline, without presenting it as proof.
The shared lawyer links the trust to the shell company. Elena requests the underlying documents through legal channels.
You left the dinner on your terms. Dante refrains from using the next invitation to test your loyalty.

beats: Dante offers a driver after the dinner. You decline and head toward the subway. He walks beside you, then notices you are testing whether he will insist.
I hate that I can’t guarantee the streets are safe. That doesn’t give me the right to make your world smaller.
He steps back from the turnstile.
If you call, I’ll answer. If you don’t, I’ll respect that too.

then: I did not expect you to answer my uncle. Thank you for speaking for yourself.
The accounting trail you requested continues toward Pier Nine.
I left when you asked. My uncle does not get to decide your place at any table.

beats: On the platform, a message arrives from an unknown number: ASK HIM WHAT HAPPENED AT PIER NINE.
You return to the top of the stairs. Dante is still outside, talking to a street vendor instead of waiting for you.
You show him the screen. For the first time, all the color leaves his face.
Pier Nine is where my brother disappeared.
Rain begins over Pier Nine. You and Elena find the same cargo code on a foundation invoice and an abandoned customs declaration.
A charitable grant cannot legally become freight insurance. Someone used the foundation as a hallway.
I know every warehouse my company rents. I did not know this one existed.
A faded photograph is nailed inside the office. A young man with Dante’s eyes stands beside a boat.
That’s Luca. My brother. We buried an empty coffin because no one ever found him.

then: Elena brings you a written privacy plan. You insisted on approving every measure, and now the team must ask you before sharing a single address.
I used to mistake speed for protection. You taught me the value of asking first.
A resident recognizes your public statement and asks you to attend the waterfront hearing as an independent speaker.
Your words changed what people are willing to say on record.
Your independent investigator finds a shipping invoice with Salvatore’s initials, separate from anything Dante’s team has shown you.
You found that without me. I want the truth more than I want credit.

beats.place: A statement in your own name

beats: The reporter calls you 'Dante's mystery woman' for the third time. You put your coffee down.
You answer in your own words—"I have a name. And this neighborhood has a name. You could try using either."
We have one confirmed fact: tenants were served notices by a company whose beneficial owner is undisclosed.
And one thing we do not know: who paid for the photograph. I will not fill that gap with a convenient story.
You can feel the interview tilting away from your appearance and toward the people whose homes are at stake.
In the back of the room, someone in a gray coat leaves before the questions end.

then: June speaks for herself. The segment airs without using your relationship as its title.
Elena files the request before the interview clip even finishes uploading.

opts.t: Decline the rest of the interview.
then: The crew respects your refusal. Dante does not chase the cameras to repair his image.

beats: The safe apartment offered by Moretti security is bright and tasteful, down to the flowers in the kitchen. It is also across the hall from a guard's office.
You ask to see the building's exit policy. Vince produces a single-page sheet that mentions escorts after dark.
An escort is a service if you request it. Otherwise it's a watcher. Rewrite this.
Dante looks at the flowers, then the door that leads outside.
I chose the apartment. I didn't give you a choice. That's the problem.
He asks whether you would rather return to your own place, use a hotel you select, or stay here with a privacy agreement. You are not rewarded for choosing the safest-looking option.
When you decline to answer immediately, he hands you Elena's number instead of his own.

choices.t: Ask him to tell the truth now.
then: 'Then sit with me. This will not make me look good.'

choices.t: Let him choose when, but insist on honesty.
Investigate the message before talking.
then: You preserve the sender details and avoid telling anyone except Elena.

en.title: The Brother He Lost

goal.zh: Reveal culpability without self-pity or forced comfort.
goal.en: Reveal culpability without self-pity or forced comfort.

then: June’s interview is picked up by local news under her own name, not as a footnote to your romance.
The beneficial-owner request is accepted for review; Elena warns the response may take time.
The newsroom stops calling for comment. Nobody on Dante’s team speaks in your name.

beats: The cafe by Pier Nine has cracked tiles and a clock that runs five minutes slow. Dante has never brought a date here.
My brother Luca was nineteen. He found that my father’s people were using the waterfront project to hide missing money.
I told him to wait. I thought I had time to fix it quietly.
He grips the cup until his fingers shake.
He went to Pier Nine alone. We never found him. I have spent six years confusing control with keeping people safe.

then: You wanted the Pier Nine truth immediately. Elena has the first documents on her desk, and you will hear them before any Moretti adviser edits the story.
You gave me time to speak. I used it to gather evidence, not to find an excuse.
You traced the anonymous message. Vince found a second sender, and now we have a lead that does not depend on my family.

beats: Elena arrives with a partial ledger. The transfers lead from the scholarship fund to an old port company. The signature on the final page is not Dante’s.
The authorization belongs to Salvatore. But a second signature was erased.
Luca wanted someone to look. I looked away because I was afraid of what I’d find.
If you decide this is too much, I’ll understand. If you stay, it has to be because you want me—not because you feel sorry for me.
Dante takes you to a public bench instead of the family crypt. He says the story belongs to his brother, not to a monument.
When Luca was sixteen, he wanted to repair fishing boats. I told him Morettis did not do small things.
He rubs his hands together, searching for something to blame that is not himself.
I thought love meant keeping him in the family. It took losing him to see the difference between keeping someone and keeping them safe.
There is space beside him, and space between you. Neither belongs to anyone else.
A letter arrives in Luca's handwriting. Not a confession. A list of places where he once felt safe: a library, a pier bench, Mara's back room.
I told people he was gone because I couldn't survive telling them I didn't know. That was cowardice.
The dates match the shell-company transfers. He may have seen something before he disappeared.
You answer in your own words—"Then we protect his right to decide whether he comes home."
Dante reads the letter again, stopping at a sentence written in the margin: DON'T MAKE HER PAY FOR YOUR FEAR.
He means our mother. He might mean you, too.

beats.hint: How do you protect Luca’s autonomy?

opts.t: Send a message offering help, no demand to meet.
then: Dante writes: "You owe me nothing. If you need a lawyer, Elena knows the way."

opts.t: Give Elena sole control of the contact route.
then: Elena confirms she will not share Luca’s location with Dante without consent.

opts.t: Ask Dante what reconciliation would require from him.
then: He replies: "An apology without a request attached. And patience I should have learned years ago."

beats.place: A memory that was not a clue

beats: On the pier bench, Dante remembers Luca teaching him to fold paper boats. He fumbles the first one and laughs at himself.
He said the point wasn't to float forever. It was to go somewhere.
Elena arrives with news: the original transfer records are archived with an independent registrar. She asks that you decide whether you want to be named in the filing.
Dante doesn't ask you to convince Luca to return. He folds a second boat and leaves it on the bench for a child who stops to watch.
I keep looking for evidence that I loved him properly. I think I have to accept that love isn't evidence.
The case gains a document. The afternoon also holds a memory that belongs only to brothers.

choices.t: Hold his hand and stay.
then: His shoulders finally lower. 'I’m not used to being allowed to grieve.'

choices.t: Ask how he plans to make amends.
then: He commits to a public independent audit, even if it implicates his family.

choices.t: Keep emotional distance and help Elena.
then: Dante thanks you for treating the truth as important even without promising romance.

en.title: The Key He Refuses to Give You

goal.zh: Let the romance handle privacy and mutual autonomy maturely.
goal.en: Let the romance handle privacy and mutual autonomy maturely.

then: Elena passes on your message: Luca is welcome to ask for help without agreeing to a reunion.
The attorney-only channel remains intact. Even Dante does not receive Luca’s address.
Dante drafts an apology to Luca without asking him for anything in return. He does not send it until Elena says contact is welcome.

beats: You discover a sealed room in Dante’s library. Inside are storage boxes labeled LUCA — PRIVATE. He finds you at the door.
I know what you’re thinking. Why invite you into my life, then lock a part of it?
He takes a breath instead of reaching for the key.
Those boxes contain letters Luca wrote to me. Some are cruel. All of them are private. I need to choose when I can share them.

then: You stayed when I spoke about Luca. I had forgotten what it felt like to finish a sentence without being interrupted.
You asked me to repair the damage, not just apologize. The independent audit is open to Elena and the residents.
You chose the investigation over comforting me. Good. The people on the waterfront deserved answers first.

beats: You notice a framed map by the door. A handwritten circle marks a ferry terminal in New Jersey.
Luca used to disappear there to sketch boats. He said he wanted a life nobody had arranged for him.
Dante meets your eyes. The room stays locked. He does not pretend that love means unlimited access.
I want to be honest with you without turning either of us inside out. Can we do that?
Salvatore’s lawyer offers a prepared statement blaming the missing brother for the fraudulent transfers.
If we publish this, Luca cannot defend himself. The evidence does not support it.
Destroy the draft, not the copy Elena needs for evidence. We are done sacrificing people for appearances.
He looks at you before entering the family meeting. He is asking for perspective, not loyalty.
If I forget that distinction, tell me. I’m not asking you to make me good. I’m asking you not to flatter me when I’m wrong.
On the table are three objects: an apartment key, an emergency contact card, and an envelope with a blank front.
The key is an option. The card is information. The envelope contains the exact terms of the private security agreement, which you can refuse.
You answer in your own words—"Why would you put them together?"
Because I used to think safety and access were the same thing. I'm trying to separate them.
You open the envelope. The final paragraph says his team has no right to enter your home, access your device, or share your movements without specific permission.
If I ever forget that, I want you to have it in writing.

beats.hint: Which offer, if any, do you accept?

then: He puts the key away without looking wounded. "Good. That is what choice means."

opts.t: Read the agreement with Elena first.
then: Elena adds a termination clause you can activate at any time.
He clears the table and asks whether you would like tea instead.

beats.place: The letter nobody opens for you

beats: A courier delivers an envelope addressed not to Dante, but to Elena. Inside is a request from Luca: no family contact until the harbor case is resolved.
He has a lawyer. My role is to respect his instruction, not interpret it into something softer.
Dante holds the unopened envelope by one edge and passes it to her.
I want to know he's safe. I don't have the right to demand the answer.
Later he asks you about a book you are reading. The sudden change of subject surprises you.
I don't want every conversation with you to be about my problems. Tell me something that belongs to your life.
For fifteen minutes the locked library becomes a place with no secrets at all, only a story you chose to share.

choices.t: Respect the letters and ask about the ferry.
then: He tells you Luca’s favorite route and shares a genuine happy memory.

choices.t: Say trust also requires transparency about danger.
then: He agrees to separate private grief from risks that affect you.

choices.t: Ask for time alone.
then: He opens the library’s garden door. 'I’ll be downstairs if you need me.'

en.title: The Offer

goal.zh: Put agency, accountability and community welfare above romance spectacle.
goal.en: Put agency, accountability and community welfare above romance spectacle.

then: The emergency card remains in your possession; Dante has not used it as an excuse to visit.
Elena’s revised agreement includes an immediate termination right and a clear complaint process.
No keys have changed hands. Dante continues to ask before entering your personal life.

beats: The audit finds three years of diverted scholarship funds. Salvatore offers a deal: he will return the money if Dante resigns and you disappear from public life.
No one is hurt. That is the beauty of compromise.
The students were hurt. And you don’t get to bargain with another person’s life.
We can refer the evidence to independent prosecutors, but the board could freeze the foundation first.
The students’ tuition payments are due in ten days.

then: You let Luca keep his letters. I can tell you what the ferry records say without stealing his privacy.
You were right to demand facts about the risk. There are two names in the report I have not explained.
I did not come after you when you asked for space. I hope that made room for this conversation to be your choice.

beats: I used money to keep people quiet before. That ends here.
We need an emergency bridge fund and a protected witness. The second erased signature may belong to one.
Dante looks at you, not for permission to save himself, but to ask whether you have an idea the room has missed.
You’ve seen this problem from outside my family. What am I missing?
June’s scholarship bill is due Friday. Elena sets three proposals on the table; all three carry a risk.
We can use an escrow account controlled by residents. That buys time but costs Dante his signature authority.
Good. I have had more authority than I knew how to use.
A call arrives from the bank: the funds are frozen pending a review. June waits outside, twisting the strap of her backpack.
I can promise to keep showing up until we fix it. I cannot promise a miracle by morning.

beats.place: The vote that cannot be bought

beats: At the boardroom entrance, a representative of the residents' council refuses to surrender her speaking slot to Dante.
You funded the building. You do not own the people inside it.
Salvatore's attorney places a new offer on the table: preserve the Moretti brand, settle privately, and keep the harbor project on schedule.
The offer includes a confidentiality clause that would prevent displaced tenants from comparing their experiences.
You read the final paragraph aloud. Dante turns the folder facedown.
No. Not if the price of peace is everyone else's silence.

beats.hint: What do you demand before a vote?

then: The council receives a revised document it can discuss openly.

opts.t: Require an independent resident seat on the board.
then: Elena drafts a bylaw amendment that does not depend on Dante remaining in power.

opts.t: Ask for a pause and legal review.
then: The vote is postponed. No one is forced to trade safety for speed.

beats.place: The first person to say no

beats: The foundation board calls an emergency vote to accept Salvatore's settlement. The votes are counted before the residents have received a copy.
They need my signature to say students were consulted. I never saw the document.
Elena stops the clerk from filing the minutes. Dante could simply order the board to reverse course. Instead he asks June to explain on record why the process was invalid.
I won't sign a lie, even if it means losing my scholarship.
Then we find a different way to fund it. You should never have had to make that trade.
The residents obtain a second vote under public observation. For the first time, the outcome might go against Dante's wishes—and he seems prepared to accept it.

choices.t: Propose an independent emergency scholarship fund.
then: Elena drafts the plan; Dante gives up control over the new fund.

choices.t: Push for immediate disclosure of the accounts.
then: The board erupts, but the evidence cannot quietly disappear.

choices.t: Find the erased second signer first.
then: You and Elena trace a dormant marina payroll account.

en.title: A Room Without Cameras

goal.zh: First intimacy must be invited and consent-based.
goal.en: First intimacy must be invited and consent-based.

then: The residents read the revised agreement in full because no gag clause forbids them from comparing notes.
The board now has an independent resident voice; Dante can no longer veto that seat by himself.
The delayed vote allows a legal review that identifies two more problematic land-transfer clauses.

beats: After a brutal day, Dante asks whether you would like ten minutes somewhere quiet. He takes you to a rooftop greenhouse built by his mother. No cameras, no staff, no velvet ropes.
My mother grew basil here because it survived my neglect.
He kneels to repot a plant. The great Dante Moretti gets dirt beneath his nails.
The first time you said no to me, I thought I was angry. I wasn’t. I was relieved you believed you could.

then: The emergency scholarship fund has an independent board now. Your idea changed who holds the money.
The accounts are published, including the numbers my own lawyers wanted to hide.
Elena found the erased second signature. We can finally name the person who approved the transfer.

beats: Rain taps on the glass. He moves beside you but leaves a clear space.
I want to kiss you. I can live with you saying no. What I can’t keep doing is pretending I don’t want to ask.
He waits. Even the rain seems to slow down.
The greenhouse smells of wet earth and rosemary. Dante has put his phone in a drawer where you can see it.
My mother called this the only room where the plants were allowed to disobey me.
You find an old photograph of him as a teenager, holding a crooked flowerpot and grinning openly.
That person is still in here somewhere. I think you keep meeting him before I do.
He asks for a kiss only after leaving the choice entirely with you. Whatever you decide, he stays and listens.

then: When Dante reaches for your hand, he remembers the boundary you set. He stops and waits for an unmistakable invitation.
You set the terms. I remember.
You spent several days apart after the surveillance argument. The reunion is awkward, honest, and unscripted.
I did not send anyone after you. I missed you. Those are two different things.
Vince presents the independent security audit you requested. The report documents deleted location logs and a policy requiring opt-in permission.
Signed, dated, and independently reviewed. You can check every line.

beats.place: What a private room is for

beats: The living room is quiet. Dante has switched off the smart speakers and put their covers in a drawer. You can see the power cords unplugged.
I want there to be one place we can have a conversation without my world listening.
You answer in your own words—"Privacy is not the same as secrecy."
I know. If the conversation changes a decision that affects someone else, we still owe them an account.
You find a small book of his mother's recipes. Pages are stained with lemon and flour.
She wrote 'do not rush' beside almost every recipe. I spent my life ignoring the advice.

opts.t: Ask him to cook together and talk.
then: He puts on an apron and lets you choose the recipe. A burnt pan becomes an inside joke.

opts.t: Offer to hold his hand, if he wants to.
then: He says yes quietly and waits for you to close the distance.

opts.t: Say you need emotional space tonight.
then: Dante moves to another chair. He listens, without turning your distance into rejection.

beats: Rain thickens on the greenhouse roof. Dante sets a small pot of basil between you, then leans back instead of leaning closer.
Can I tell you what I want without expecting you to solve it?
You nod or say no. He waits for the actual answer.
I want to be the person you call on a terrible day. I also want to be someone you can say 'not today' to without worrying what happens next.
He takes an imperfect cutting from the plant and offers it as a joke about his gardening skills, not as a symbol of possession.
Whether you kiss him or not, the door stays open, the argument about privacy remains resolved on your terms, and he remembers the difference between tenderness and entitlement.

choices.t: Kiss him, if you want to.
then: He meets you halfway, gentle and breathless. 'Was that okay?'

choices.t: Ask him to hold your hand instead.
then: His hand is warm and unexpectedly unsteady. He smiles like the moment matters more than the empire.

choices.t: Tell him you are not ready.
then: 'Thank you for telling me.' He turns the conversation to your favorite plant.

en.title: The Witness

goal.zh: Reveal missing brother alive and reject ownership disguised as love.
goal.en: Reveal missing brother alive and reject ownership disguised as love.

then: The recipe you tried together is now stained with flour. Dante calls the burnt pan a better memory than any gala.
Dante remembers that the first touch was an invitation, not a promise of more.
Dante honors the emotional distance you asked for; he asks whether today is a better day to talk.

beats: The second signature belongs to Nora Bell, Luca’s former assistant. She has been living under a new name and agrees to speak only if she can control the conditions.
I saw Luca leave Pier Nine alive. I helped him get out.
He thought you would drag him back to the family. He left because he was afraid of you, not because he stopped loving you.
Dante looks as though the floor has shifted under his feet.

then: I still remember that kiss. I will never call it permission for anything you have not chosen.
I liked holding your hand. It was enough for that night, and it can be enough now.
You told me you were not ready. I heard you, and I am not waiting for a reward.

beats: Salvatore paid people to spread the rumor of Luca’s death. He wanted Dante obedient and guilty.
Only if nobody forces him. He runs an ocean-repair workshop now. It’s the first life he ever chose.
